name: Baby: Breastfeeding Tracker
description:
This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements. This baby tracker app will help parents get through the wonder weeks.

With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
✔️ Handy breastfeeding timer and sleep timer are easy to stop and to restart
✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

Email us your comments and suggestions, and we'll implement them as soon as possible!

Baby tracker for sleep, breastfeeding, solids & more

A positive parenting solution

Millions of parents before you have already followed, supported and stimulated the 10 leaps in the mental development of their babies. It's not a coincidence that we have been one of the best-selling baby apps worldwide for many years!

name: Caregiver: Elderly Care Log
description:
Caring for aging parents is rarely a one-person job. Reminders, doctor visits and "did anyone pick up the prescription?" messages pile up in a group chat until something slips. Caregiver Planner gives a family caregiver one calm place to organize elder care: medication reminders, tasks, appointments, a care log and the numbers you call most.

It is an organizer for the logistics of caregiving, not a medical app. It helps you plan, remind, hand over and keep track. It never gives dosing, diagnosis or treatment advice.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Profile: add the person you look after, whether a parent, a spouse or someone else, with a relationship and notes.
• Medication reminders: add each medication as printed on the label and the times you want a reminder. Log each one as taken or skipped, or snooze it for 15 minutes. The app reminds you of the time only and never suggests what or how much to take.
• Tasks: add jobs like "pick up prescription" or "call the clinic", note who is doing it, set a due date and check it off.
• Appointments: keep doctor and specialist visits with the provider, place and notes, and get a reminder before each one. After a visit, write down what was decided and turn follow-ups into tasks.
• Log: note visits, calls and updates. Group entries into concern threads ("sleep at night", "swollen ankle") so you can tell a clinician how long something has been going on.
• Contacts: save doctor, pharmacy, nurse and family numbers, and pin two to Today for a one-tap call.
• Rotation: set a weekly pattern of who is on duty and when, with an end-of-shift reminder.
• Handoff brief: reminder times, the next tasks and appointments, recent updates and who to call, ready to send to a sibling or save as a PDF.
• A weekly recap you can share, and a log export as a PDF for your own records.
• Prep checklists: pick a situation (specialist visit, hospital discharge, home safety, organizing medications, new diagnosis questions, in-home help, documents) and get an organizational checklist of questions to ask, papers to bring and jobs to divide up.

FREE TO START, NO SIGN-UP

Start as a guest right away; your plan stays on your phone. The free version covers one person:
• up to 5 active medication reminders
• unlimited tasks, appointments, log entries and contacts
• handoff brief, weekly recap and PDF export
• one AI checklist to try

The free version shows ads: banners for our other apps and an occasional full-screen ad after you save a task or an appointment.

PRO, FOR FAMILIES WHO SHARE THE LOAD

• Care Circle: invite siblings and other helpers with a code and post tasks, log notes and duty shifts to a shared feed everyone in the circle sees. It updates when the app opens or when you refresh.
• More than one person, each with their own Today, tasks and schedule.
• Unlimited medication reminders.
• Unlimited AI prep checklists, plus AI visit preparation and follow-up suggestions (up to 30 a month).
• Cloud backup and restore (with a free account).
• No ads.

Pro is a monthly or annual subscription. The free senior care organizer stays useful on its own.

YOUR DATA

As a guest, your plan is stored on your phone. Care Circle and cloud backup store the shared or backed-up items on our servers. AI checklists and suggestions are drafted by a third-party AI service (OpenRouter), only after you agree; medication names and recent log entries are sent only if you switch that option on. We use Firebase for sign-in, analytics and crash reports, and Google AdMob for ads in the free version.

NOT MEDICAL ADVICE

Caregiver Planner helps you coordinate the day-to-day of looking after an elderly parent or loved one. It does not provide medical, dosing or health advice. For any medical question, consult a licensed professional; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: Caregiver Timesheet & Mileage
description:
A month ends and two people remember the same hours differently. Yours are in your head, theirs are in theirs, and the one without proof is the one who loses. This app takes the remembering out of it: every shift is stamped the moment it happens, and the family signs the page that adds them up.

It is for the caregiver a family hires and pays directly. Elder care and companion care, respite, private duty, a nanny, housekeeping, a personal care assistant, a home health aide, a direct care worker, a family member paid for the hours.

WHEN YOU WALK IN
Today lists the families you work for. Tap one and the shift starts where you stand, running as a counter instead of a number you rebuild on Sunday night. A notification carries a live timer and a Clock out button while it runs, and a home screen widget clocks in and out too, showing the family name and the hours so far.

OVERNIGHTS AND HOLIDAYS, PRICED THE WAY YOU AGREED
Mark the sleep-in window on an overnight and those hours come off the paid hours. A family can be set to a flat amount per night instead, and the sheet counts the nights. Holiday hours are the days you ticked yourself: no country's holiday list ships with this app, because which days carry a holiday rate is part of what you agreed.

MILES, AND MONEY YOU LAID OUT
Log each drive by hand: where from, where to, the distance and what it was for. It goes on that family's timesheet at the mileage rate you agreed with them.

THE SIGNATURE IS THE POINT
At the end of a pay period, hand the phone across. Hand-off mode shows that one timesheet and refuses to leave the screen without your PIN, so your other families, your rates and your settings are not on the phone they hold. They sign on the glass, type their name and how they are related, and the moment they signed prints beside it.

AFTER THE SIGNATURE, THE FIGURES STOP MOVING
Every shift, drive and item inside a signed period refuses to be edited. A correction is a new sheet that points back at the signed one, so nothing is quietly rewritten behind a signature. The page marks a shift typed in afterwards, one whose times were corrected, a device clock that changed and a phone that restarted, then prints the rules it used.

WHAT LEAVES THE PHONE
A one page PDF: every shift, the hours, the distance, what you laid out, the total due and both signatures, with the receipt photographs behind it. A record and a client invoice in one document. There is also a year summary family by family, a CSV export, and a backup locked with a passphrase you choose and the app never keeps. Log what a family has paid and Today holds a list of the sheets still owed.

NO ACCOUNT, NO SERVER, NO ADVERTS
Nothing to sign into. Your hours, drives, receipt photos and signatures are written to this phone and stay on it; the only thing the app reaches out to is Google Play, to ask what you have bought. No adverts at any level: a family is handed this phone to sign on, and a banner under a signature makes the page look like something to doubt.

WHAT THIS APP IS NOT
It is not an agency system and not an Electronic Visit Verification system. If your visits are billed to Medicaid through an agency, the EVV app they issued you is the one that counts, and this does not stand in for it. This is the private arrangement: your hours, your mileage, your money, signed by the family who pays you. It holds nothing medical and is not tax advice.

Currency, miles or kilometres, week start, date order and a 12 or 24 hour clock are yours to set. Reminders can say you are still clocked in, that a pay period closes today, or that a week has gone since your last backup.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency. Not a medical device and not medical advice.
https://www.medicaid.gov/medicaid/home-community-based-services/guidance/electronic-visit-verification-evv/index.html

name: Senior Helper: Elderly Aid
description:
Watching a parent or grandparent struggle with small buttons, confusing menus and accidental taps on a smartphone? Senior Helper solves that.

Senior Helper is a phone app for older adults and the visually impaired. The home screen shows just four large buttons. Each fills a quarter of the screen. Big icons, big text, nothing else. No ads, no popups, no clutter.

📞 PHONE
A dialler where every digit fills a third of the screen width. Plus key for international numbers. The call button is full-width and green. The contacts list shows names large and phone numbers below. Contacts can be added manually or imported from the phone's address book one at a time or all at once. The delete button is small to avoid accidental taps. When more than five contacts are saved, a separate selection mode appears for deleting many contacts at once.

🔦 FLASHLIGHT
One tap from the home screen turns the flashlight on. The icon changes immediately, the off-state bulb becomes a bulb with rays so you can see at a glance that the light is on. Five minutes later it turns off automatically, so the battery won't drain if it was left on by accident.

🚨 SOS EMERGENCY
In a moment of panic or sudden illness, an older person may struggle to remember a phone number or even who to call. Senior Helper takes that pressure away. The large red SOS button is right there on the home screen. One tap, and they know the right person will be reached - no numbers to recall, no menus to navigate, no decisions to make under stress.

A thirty second countdown starts on tap. The cancel button is full-width and taller than any other button. During the last fifteen seconds it flashes white and red to make accidental taps impossible to miss. When the countdown ends, the app calls a previously chosen contact. The SOS contact can be entered manually or picked from the phone's contacts list. One number, one action, no confusion.

🔍 MAGNIFIER
The phone's camera becomes a digital magnifying glass. The zoom-in and zoom-out buttons are large. A built-in light helps in low-light conditions, the rear flash turns on and the camera view brightens. Useful for reading medication labels, price tags or newspapers.

🔐 PRIVACY
Senior Helper does not collect, transmit or share your data. Contacts stay on your phone. The camera is used only for the flashlight and magnifier, never for taking pictures or video. No internet required. No ads.

👨‍👩‍👧 GREAT FOR FAMILY HELPERS
A family member can install the app on grandma's or grandpa's phone, set the SOS contact to their own number, and add a few contacts up front. After that, the senior uses the app independently with no guidance.

Simple, big, in plain English. The way a phone for an older adult should be.

name: Elderly Safety Assistant
description:
Client Safety Assistant helps caregivers stay connected with the people they support, using only the phones they already have.

The app has two simple roles: client and caregiver. A client can share their location, battery status and SOS alerts with trusted caregivers. A caregiver can
monitor one or more clients, switch between them, view their latest location, manage safe zones and coordinate care with notes, appointments and medication
entries.

Key features:

- Secure client-caregiver pairing with a short code or QR scan
- Background location sharing from the client phone, with permission
- Large SOS button for urgent help requests
- Battery and last-active status so caregivers know if a phone may be offline
- Safe zones with alerts when a client enters or leaves a configured area
- Shared notes for care updates
- Private notes visible only to the author
- Shared appointments and medication lists
- Multiple caregivers per client and multiple clients per caregiver
- Content-free push notifications for SOS and safe-zone events

Location sharing starts only after pairing is accepted. Clients and caregivers can remove a link at any time. Location, SOS-location and safe-zone data are end-
to-end encrypted between paired devices.

Client Safety Assistant is designed for care coordination and safety awareness. It does not replace emergency services, professional medical care or direct
supervision. In an emergency, contact local emergency services immediately.

What’s New
Initial release with secure pairing, background location sharing, SOS alerts, safe zones, battery status, shared notes, appointments and medications.

Background Location Permission Declaration
Client devices use background location so linked caregivers can see the client’s last known position and receive SOS or safe-zone alerts even when the phone is
locked or the app is closed. Location sharing starts only after the client grants permission and accepts pairing with a caregiver. Caregiver devices do not use
background location for caregiver tracking.

In-App Prominent Disclosure Text
Allow background location so your linked caregivers can see your last known location and receive SOS and safe-zone alerts when this phone is locked or the app
is closed. Your location is shared only with caregivers you approve.

Data Safety Summary
Data collected: precise location, battery/status data, SOS alerts, profile name/photo, notes, appointments, medications, push notification token and technical
operational data.

Purpose: app functionality, care coordination, safety alerts, account pairing, security and troubleshooting.

Sharing: data is shared with actively paired clients/caregivers and service providers used to operate the app, including Supabase and Firebase Cloud Messaging.

Security: data is encrypted in transit. Location, SOS-location and safe-zone data are end-to-end encrypted between paired devices. Notes, appointments and
medications are protected by access controls but are not currently end-to-end encrypted.

Deletion: users can remove pairings in the app and request account/data deletion via info@nextact.is.

GETTING STARTED
Three steps: pick your dog's breed, enter age and weight, you're in. No sign-in needed for core features. Family Sharing and Paw Pals exchange connect with your Google account in one tap.

WALK PLANNING
Your dog's breed, age, weight, and energy level drive personalized recommendations: walks per day, minutes each, distance. A high-energy breed gets longer walks; a calmer one gets shorter; a senior gets gentler sessions; a puppy gets a careful start. Pick a destination on the map for a suggested route. Adjust on the fly.

WEATHER & PAW SAFETY
Summer pavement in Japan can hit 60°C (140°F)+ — hot enough to burn unprotected paw pads. WanWanWalk reads temperature, humidity, ground temp, and UV index in real time, then surfaces a Safe / Caution / Danger gauge. In winter, the same gauge warns about freezing surfaces. Today's best walk windows (morning, evening) come from the day's weather curve. Push notifications fire before conditions worsen.

VET RECORDS & CARE EVENTS
Show any new vet your dog's full medical history on your phone, instantly. Vaccinations, rabies certificates, visit notes, prescriptions — all in one place. Attach photos, PDFs, X-rays. One tap exports a shareable PDF you can email. Each vaccination is date-stamped so you know when boosters are due.

Daily care is one tap from Home — fed, treat, meds, toilet, groomed. The chip stamps the time, so "when did I last feed her?" is always answered. In a shared household, every member sees who did what and when.

FAMILY SHARING

name: Pet Medication & Pill Reminder
description:
A simple pet pill reminder and pet medication tracker for dog and cat owners. Add your dog or cat, add each medicine as your vet prescribed it with the time it is due, and get a reminder on your phone when it is time. Tap Log dose or Skip, and the Today view moves on to the next one — no sticky notes on the fridge, no guessing whether this morning's tablet already went in.

Everything you log becomes a medication history for your dog or cat: what was given, what was skipped and what was missed, day by day. Before a checkup or a refill, Pro lets you export a vet-ready summary of that history and share it with the clinic or another caregiver.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Today view — what is due next, today's schedule and anything missed across all your pets, with Log dose, Skip and Undo
• Pet pill reminder — a notification at each scheduled time with the medication name and your animal's name
• Medication schedules — a daily reminder time, a start date and an optional end date for a course; with Pro, several times a day or only on chosen weekdays
• Pet profiles — name, dog or cat, and a photo, each with its own medicine list
• Any medicine — antibiotics, heart medication, joint supplements, dewormers, flea and tick or heartworm prevention. You type the name and the dose exactly as prescribed
• Notes on each medicine — with food, from the prescription label, anything worth remembering
• History — everything given and skipped, grouped by day, with a filter for each animal
• Vet-ready summary (Pro) — export the log as text and share it from your phone
• Several animals — filter the Today view and the history by name when several of them are on different medicines
• Available in 10 languages

WHY A PET MEDICATION REMINDER
• Built for pets — each dog or cat has its own list, so you always know which pill is due and for whom
• A pet pill reminder that lives on your phone — alerts are scheduled locally, so they still arrive when you have no signal
• An honest record — Log dose, Skip and Undo write down exactly what happened, so the record you show your vet is real
• Simple for one animal, useful for several — one pet medication reminder for a single daily tablet, or for a few animals on overlapping courses

WHO IT IS FOR
• Dog and cat owners whose animal is on a course of medication
• Homes with several dogs or cats taking medicines at the same time
• Owners managing long-term pet meds — heart conditions, arthritis, allergies — or monthly flea, tick and heartworm prevention
• Anyone who wants a pet medication tracker and a clean log for the vet instead of relying on memory

FREE AND PRO
Free: up to 2 pets, unlimited medications, one reminder time a day per medication, the Today view, logging and the full history in the app. The free version shows ads.
Pro: unlimited pets, several reminder times a day, weekday schedules, the vet-ready history export, and no ads. Pro is an optional in-app purchase. The price is shown in the app before you buy, and a subscription can be cancelled at any time in your Google Play account.

YOUR DATA
Your pets, medications, history and photos are stored on your phone and are not uploaded. When you start, the app opens an anonymous guest session (creating an account is optional). It uses Firebase for sign-in, analytics and crash reports, RevenueCat for purchases, and an ad service in the free version. You can delete your account from Settings.

IMPORTANT — NOT VETERINARY ADVICE
This app is a reminder and record-keeping tool, not veterinary advice. It does not diagnose, prescribe, calculate or check a dose, and never tells you whether a medicine or an amount is safe for your animal. Enter the dose exactly as your vet prescribed, and ask your vet about any medical question, a missed or double dose, side effects or an emergency. Phone settings can delay or block notifications, so do not rely on the app alone for critical medication.

SEE WHAT IS WORKING
Potty training can feel unpredictable, but tracking each potty sit, success, and accident can reveal helpful patterns. Sprout helps you understand your child’s routine by showing catch rates, dry stretches, weekly trends, and the times of day when accidents are most likely.

As your child becomes more consistent, Sprout can suggest when it may be appropriate to increase the time between potty visits. The Potty Training Timer grows with your routine, helping you move from frequent reminders toward greater independence.

BUILD A GENTLE, CONSISTENT ROUTINE
Potty training is not about pressure. It is about timing, encouragement, and consistency. Sprout helps you create a calm routine so accidents can become less frequent and dry days can become the norm.

Use the Potty Training Timer to guide each day, celebrate progress, and gradually reduce reminders until your little one no longer needs the timer at all.

name: Life Notes - Symptom Tracking
description:
I'm developing this app on my own in my spare time outside of work, so that I can continue to offer it for free.

This app is free, ad-free, and without data collection. Forever.

You and you alone are responsible for your data, which is why it is not stored online.
Remember to create backup files regularly so that you don't lose them.
(Settings > Import / Export)

Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

It's possible to create your own symptom list in order to score them day after day, rating thef pain level intensity on a scale from 0 to 5.

It's also possible to record your meals, medications and add various notes, as well as your sleep schedules to highlight the causes of your symptoms. For example, it is easier to highlight the link between some of your meals and your possible stomach aches.

In addition to noting the daily evolution of the symptoms at different times of the day, it's also possible to enter an overall level of pain intensity over the course of a day in order to have a broader view of their evolution.

In short, Life-Notes offers what a simple notebook could do for you, but with a focus on tracking symptoms and providing statistics.

None of your data is sent online, 100% of your data is stored on your phone's memory.

Available languages: English, French

-Track symptoms over time to notice recurring patterns
-Use it as a pain tracker for headaches, joint pain, or fatigue
-Track moods and emotional changes as a mood diary

-Keep a personal wellness log or health journal

Key features
-Symptom tracking and symptom logging
-Summary Pages for quick history
-Powerful filters to narrow down symptoms
-Insights and graphs
-Backups and Restoration
-Data stored on your device with no cloud syncing or sharing

Symtally was created by someone living with a chronic illness, informed by personal experience with lupus. The app is built to support personal tracking and awareness, not medical diagnosis or treatment.

name: Upright – POTS Symptom Tracker
description:
Upright is a POTS tracker for people living with POTS (postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome), dysautonomia and the conditions that travel with them. Diagnosed or still chasing answers, Upright turns confusing daily symptoms into clear patterns you and your doctor can act on.

ONE POTS APP FOR YOUR WHOLE DAILY ROUTINE
POTS is managed every single day: salt loading, fluids, the standing heart rate test, medications and avoiding triggers. Upright brings your whole POTS routine into one simple dysautonomia tracker, with a Today screen that shows where you stand at a glance.

STANDING HEART RATE TEST (NASA LEAN TEST)
Record your resting heart rate lying down and your peak heart rate standing. Upright flags a rise of 30 bpm or more, the threshold used for POTS, and charts your standing heart rate over days and weeks. Add blood pressure readings to the same test: lying, then each standing measurement.

SALT, FLUID & ELECTROLYTE TRACKER
Log sodium and fluids in one tap and watch progress rings fill toward the daily targets your doctor set. For POTS, salt and electrolytes are frontline treatment, not a gimmick.

POTS SYMPTOM TRACKER & FLARE DIARY
Log dizziness, brain fog, racing heart, fatigue, nausea and fainting with a severity score and triggers like heat, standing, big meals and your menstrual cycle. Trends compares your symptom days with your low-salt days so you can see what sets off a POTS flare.

TRIGGER CORRELATIONS (PRO)
See each trigger ranked by how many episodes you tagged with it, its share of your flares and the average severity, over the last 30 days.

MEDICATION REMINDERS
Add midodrine, fludrocortisone, salt tablets, beta blockers or any other POTS medication with its dose and times. Upright reminds you when each dose is due, even when the app is closed, and tracks your adherence for the doctor report.

HISTORY
Browse every day you logged: salt, fluids, stand test and symptom episodes. The free plan keeps the last 30 days in view; Pro unlocks your full POTS history.

WEARABLE HEART RATE VIA HEALTH CONNECT (PRO)
With your permission, Upright reads the heart rate samples your watch recorded, through Health Connect and read-only, to fill in the resting and standing values of your stand test. Heart rate data is used only for the stand test and its trends, stays on your device and is never uploaded or shared.

DOCTOR-READY PDF & CSV REPORTS (PRO)
Export a POTS report with standing heart rate trends, symptom frequency, your top trigger, medication adherence and salt and fluid averages. Bring evidence to your cardiologist instead of a vague memory.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No cloud. Works offline. Your health data never leaves your device.

BUILT FOR THE DYSAUTONOMIA COMMUNITY
POTS, dysautonomia, MCAS, EDS and hypermobility, long COVID and every spoonie managing a chronic illness. Upright speaks English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish and Portuguese.

UPRIGHT PRO
PDF and CSV doctor reports, wearable heart rate sync, full trigger correlations and unlimited history. Start with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan; monthly and lifetime plans are available too. Invite a friend and you both get 30 days of Pro free.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Upright is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Stand test results and trends are for tracking only, not a diagnosis. Always consult your doctor or a qualified healthcare professional before changing your salt, fluid or medication routine. If you faint and are injured, have chest pain or feel seriously unwell, seek emergency care.

Two ways to use Wave Health
Wave Health works as an independent app, or connected to your hospital and care team.

Key App Features:
- Symptom Logging: Track your daily symptoms and keep a log to bring to your care team – sleep, water, moods, physical activity, mental health, mindfulness, journal entries, and more.

For hospitals and care coordinators who want to monitor their patients using the app:
- Scheduled Symptom Reviews: Submit check-ins reviewed by clinicians via a risk-ranked action list.

- Review Notifications: Get notified when a submission is reviewed, with any clinician message.
- Risk-Ranked Auto-Sorting: Automated triage routes low-risk reports away from the queue, with at-risk patients on top.
- Auto-Close: No-risk submissions close automatically and are hidden from the default inbox, accessible only via filter.
- Expired/Superseded Logic: A new submission automatically expires any prior unreviewed one, preventing task buildup.
- Secure Messaging & Follow-Up: Clinicians follow up on submissions for e-prescriptions, treatment changes, and structured escalation.

Created from a Real Life Cancer Journey
Our founders underwent a cancer journey 7 years ago, which sparked the idea of Wave Health. We understand what it’s like to be faced with a major health diagnosis, and all that comes with it.

Certifications & Standards UKCA & CE Class 1a SaMD (MHRA) · DTAC compliant · ORCHA 90% · ISO/IEC 27001 · ISO 13485 · ISO 14971 · ISO 9001 · DCB 0129 · Cyber Essentials Certified · HIPAA & GDPR-compliant (AWS London).

name: Pain Diary Tracker - PainTrack
description:
PainTrack is your free pain diary with a body map and medication reminders: see where it hurts, what you took and whether it helped. Simple, private and right on your phone.

Log your pain in seconds, watch how it develops over weeks and months and find out what affects your symptoms. All your data stays on your device: no account, no server of ours.

WHICH CONDITIONS?

PainTrack is a symptom diary, headache diary and migraine diary in one app. You set up your own pain definitions: migraine and headaches, back and neck pain, joint pain from arthritis, fibromyalgia, endometriosis, nerve pain and other chronic pain.

BODY MAP AND HISTORY

• Body map: set where your pain is located and see which areas bother you most often. With arthritis or fibromyalgia you can mark several areas
• History and weekly trends across one or several pains
• Event markers: note the day you changed a medication or started a therapy

YOUR MEDICATIONS AT A GLANCE

• Medications with reminders: regular medication like a patch every 72 hours or fixed times, as-needed medication with a quick button
• Log doses right from the reminder or in a pain entry, and if you like, get asked how you feel afterwards
• Effect over time (Pro): how your pain behaves in the hours after a dose

LOGGED IN SECONDS

• Quick entry on the Today page: one tap on the scale and you're done
• Three scales: 0-10, Yes/No or Mild/Moderate/Severe
• Tap the circumstances instead of writing them down: 26 suggestions such as "slept poorly", plus your own tags
• Daily reminders, skipped once you have logged

As a headache diary, PainTrack shows how many days a month you were in pain. As a migraine diary, it records attacks, triggers and medications. As a symptom diary, it also tracks complaints without a scale, simply with Yes/No.

SPOT THE PATTERNS

• Trigger analysis (Pro): which circumstances, pain types and weekdays go with higher intensity, in plain sentences
• Monthly reports (Pro): days logged, average, pain-free days and the change from the previous month
• Insight of the day, streak and milestones, dark mode

A FREE PAIN DIARY

The free version is not a trial period. You track one pain definition and one medication for as long as you like, with all three scales, notes, tags, reminders, the body map, event markers and analysis over 7 and 30 days. The Diary shows the last three months; nothing is deleted.

PAINTRACK PRO

• Unlimited pain definitions and medications
• Effect over time, trigger analysis and event analysis
• Monthly reports
• Body map and analysis over 90 days and all time
• Your whole Diary with no time limit
• PDF doctor's report
• Data export and import plus CSV export

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account, no sign-up, no server of ours. Your entries are encrypted on your phone, and we never see them. Lock the app with your fingerprint or face if you want to.

FOR YOUR DOCTOR'S APPOINTMENT

Many doctors and pain specialists ask for a pain diary. With PainTrack Pro it becomes a PDF doctor's report: pick the pains, the period and the sections, with charts and medications, ready to share.

PainTrack Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time purchase. The yearly subscription comes with a 7-day free trial.

The Pro subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in the Google Play Store under Payments & subscriptions.

name: PainApp: Chronic Pain Relief
description:
Retrain Your Brain. Reclaim a Life Beyond Chronic Pain.
Still living with chronic back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain—or other persistent pain that just won’t go away? Your pain is real. But it may not be coming from where you think.

Requires Subscription.
Free to download; an active subscription is required to use the app and access all features.

Pain can be learned by the brain—and the good news is: it can also be unlearned. This app helps you understand how chronic pain works and gives you the tools to gently rewire the brain’s pain pathways.

How Does It Work?
Chronic pain often continues after the body has healed. Why? Because your brain has learned to protect you by activating pain—sometimes even without injury. This is called neural circuit pain, and it’s more common than most people realize.

By using science-backed methods based on neuroplasticity, our app helps you calm the brain’s danger signals, reduce pain, and restore a sense of safety in your body.

Education Is Treatment
Knowledge is so powerful, in fact, that education about pain is a medically recognized form of treatment. Healthcare practitioners call it therapeutic neuroscience education—which is a fancy way of saying that someone is learning how pain really works in the brain.

Scientific studies show that this kind of education can:

Reduce physical pain

Improve movement and function

Lower fear and anxiety

Calm the nervous system

Support long-term recovery

Understanding pain is often the first step to relieving it.

What You’ll Find Inside the App:
Daily science-based lessons to reframe your understanding of pain

Interactive pain tracker to identify patterns and monitor your progress

Guided practices to calm fear and deactivate pain circuits

Tools to identify neural circuit pain vs. structural pain

Strategies for responding to pain triggers with confidence

Exercises that promote safety, movement, and emotional ease

Gentle coaching on how to retrain your brain using proven techniques

Who Is This App For?
You might benefit from this approach if:

You have chronic back pain, neck pain, or shoulder pain

Your pain started during a stressful time or flares with stress

Your pain changes locations, intensity, or comes and goes

You’ve been told “there’s nothing wrong,” but still feel pain

You’ve tried everything—yet nothing has worked long-term

You’re open to a mind-body approach rooted in science, not guesswork

This app is designed for people ready to understand their pain, not just manage it.

Track, Learn, Improve
Our built-in pain tracker helps you:

Log and visualize your pain patterns over time

Notice emotional or situational triggers

Spot progress and build momentum

Feel more empowered in your recovery

No Meds. No Surgery. Just Science.
This is not about positive thinking or ignoring your pain. It’s about giving your brain the right information—and practicing how to respond with calm, not fear. Over time, this helps deconstruct the neural pathways that keep pain alive.

Download Now — Start Rewiring Pain, One Step at a Time
Train your brain. Understand your pain. Live your life again.

This app provides educational content and self-management tools and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns.

Living with lupus means never knowing when the next flare will hit, and explaining an invisible illness to people who think you look fine. Lunaire Lupus Tracker is a private, offline flare and symptom diary. Everything you log stays on your phone.

Lupus flares are unpredictable, but patterns exist. Lunaire Lupus Tracker keeps your symptoms and suspected triggers — sun, stress, poor sleep, infection, food — side by side. Built for SLE, discoid lupus, drug-induced lupus and undifferentiated connective tissue disease.

FREE

Everything is stored on your device. No account required.

KEY FEATURES:
• Flare log with timeline — record each gout attack, the affected joint (body-part picker), pain level, duration and triggers, viewed as a clear date-grouped history.
• Uric acid tracker — log blood test results in mg/dL or µmol/L and watch your trend on an easy-to-read chart over time.
• Purine food database — search 425+ foods with green, yellow and red purine zones, so you can quickly tell which foods to enjoy, limit or avoid.
• Food & meal logging — record what you ate and tie high-purine intake to later flares.
• Medication tracker — log your urate-lowering and pain medicines, mark each dose as taken and set a reminder time for each medicine.
• Hydration log — track daily water intake, since staying hydrated helps flush uric acid.
• Alcohol log — record beer, wine and spirits, common gout triggers worth keeping an eye on.
• Doctor PDF export — generate a clean report of your flares, uric acid history and intake to bring to your next appointment.
• Charts & insights — spot patterns between diet, hydration, medication and your flare-ups.
• Reminders — gentle medication and hydration nudges to help you stay consistent.

WHY CHOOSE GOUT FLARE TRACKER?
• Private by design — your health data stays on your phone, no sign-up needed.
• Built around gout — purine zones, uric-acid units and flare triggers, not a generic health app.
• Doctor-friendly — export a tidy PDF summary for any appointment.
• Clean and simple — log a flare or a glass of water in seconds.
• Works offline — the full purine database and all your logs are available without internet.

PERFECT FOR:
• People managing gout or hyperuricemia day to day.
• Anyone on urate-lowering therapy who wants to track medication and results.
• Patients who want to bring organized records to their rheumatologist or GP.
• Anyone watching purine intake, hydration or alcohol to reduce flares.

A note on safety: Gout Flare Tracker is a personal logging tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Purine values are based on published nutrition data and are for general reference. Always follow the guidance of your doctor or pharmacist.

Download Gout Flare Tracker and take control of your gout — one log at a time.

name: Flare — Hot Flash Tracker
description:
You used to know how your body worked. Then something shifted.

Hot flashes without warning. Night sweats at 3am. Sudden flushes of heat that come out of nowhere. The same question, every time: why is this happening?

Flare finds the answers.


KNOW WHY, NOT JUST WHEN

Most apps just log when your hot flashes happen. Flare tells you why.

Log each hot flash or night sweat with intensity, duration, and what was happening around it — alcohol, caffeine, stress, poor sleep, spicy food, heat, or anything else you notice. Over time, Flare builds your personal trigger report: the factors that actually correlate with your worst episodes.

Look back on your patterns with real data, not just a feeling.


LOG IN SECONDS

· Intensity — rate how severe each flush felt
· Duration — how long it lasted
· Triggers — alcohol, caffeine, stress, sleep, food, heat, and more
· Notes — anything only you would know

No fertility charts. No period tracking. No features built for someone else's stage of life — just perimenopause and menopause, front and center.


YOUR TRIGGER REPORT

After a few weeks of logging, Flare's Insights screen shows which triggers correlate with your symptoms — ranked, visualized, and easy to read. See your patterns clearly, for the first time.


SHARE YOUR REPORT

Turn your trigger report into a PDF in one tap — print it, save it, or share it with anyone you choose, including your healthcare provider. A clear record of your own patterns.

Want to share your progress instead? Generate a simple, private summary card with your top trigger and stats.


BUILT FOR PRIVACY

No account. No cloud. No one has access to your health data — not us, not anyone. Everything stays on your phone, offline, always. Your body, your data, your call.

A simple, private diary for midlife — built for perimenopause and menopause, not someone else's stage of life.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Is Flare a period or fertility tracker?
No. Flare is built specifically for hot flashes and night sweats during perimenopause and menopause — no cycle charts, no ovulation predictions, no features for a different stage of life.

Do I need an account to use it?
No. There's no sign-up, no login, and no cloud sync. Your entries stay on your device.

Does Flare work during perimenopause, or only after menopause?
Both. Hot flashes and night sweats often start years before your final period — Flare tracks them at any stage, perimenopause through post-menopause.

Is this a medical or diagnostic app?

Our virtual providers are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks

You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.

Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.

WHAT IS BLUE LIGHT?
Blue light is the visible light spectrum (380-550nm) for circadian regulation. It contains more energy than other visible light types, so it may damage your retinal cells.

WHY SHOULD I USE BLUE LIGHT FILTER?
Research shows that exposure to blue light imposes serious threats to retinal neurons, causes eye strain, dry eyes, and inhibits the secretion of melatonin, a hormone that influences circadian rhythms. With our night shift function, your vision health will be greatly improved.

CAN BLUE LIGHT FILTER IMPROVE MY SLEEP?
Yes. Natural exposure to blue light during the daylight hours boosts people's energy, alertness and mood; however, it will disturb your sleep at night.(from wiki) Blue light filter can effectively reduce blue light from the screen and help you get better sleep.

RELEVANT SCIENTIFIC STUDIES 
1. Steven W. Lockley, George C. Brainard, Charles A. Czeisler. “High Sensitivity of the Human Circadian Melatonin Rhythm to Resetting by Short Wavelength Light”. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2003 Sep;88(9):4502-5.

2. Burkhart K, Phelps JR. “AMBER LENSES TO BLOCK BLUE LIGHT AND IMPROVE SLEEP: A RANDOMIZED TRIAL”. Chronobiol Int. 2009 Dec;26(8):1602-12.

Timezone converts a moment between places, keeps a world clock of the cities

WHAT MOST TIME ZONE APPS GET WRONG

A time zone is not a city, and an offset is not a time zone. A zone is a rule:
a history of offsets and the dates they changed. Almost every converter here
ignores that, looks up two offsets, subtracts them and adds the difference to
the time you typed. That is wrong three ways:

• It uses TODAY'S offsets for a date in July. London is UTC+0 now and UTC+1
then.

• It uses one country's changeover dates for another. America moves its clocks
three weeks before Europe does, so for three weeks every March New York is
four hours behind London, not five.

• It cannot represent the answer at all when the local time it was handed does
not exist, or exists twice.

Here, converting is reading one point on the timeline in another set of rules.
There is no arithmetic to get wrong.

THE TWO MORNINGS A YEAR

On the morning the clocks go forward, an hour of local time does not happen.
There is no 2:30am in New York on 8 March. On the night they go back, an hour
happens twice: 1:30am in London on 25 October is two different moments, sixty
minutes apart.

Almost every app handles this silently — it shows 3:30 when you typed 2:30, or
picks one of the two 1:30s and never mentions the other. This one says so, in a
sentence, and lets you take the second.

It also knows Britain loses a different hour from America: the clocks go
forward at 1am there, so 2:30 is an ordinary time in London that morning and a
missing one in New York.

WHEN CAN WE ALL TALK

Pick two to five places and say what hours each of them works — nine to five,
eight to four, or ten at night to six in the morning. The app shows every
stretch of the day that is inside everybody's window.

It handles the day boundary, because it never works in local dates: Tokyo's
Monday morning really is Los Angeles's Sunday afternoon. And when there is NO
overlap — the honest answer for the Pacific against the American west coast on
office hours — it says so in words, rather than showing an empty strip you will
assume failed to load.

Places forty-five minutes off the hour work properly: India, Nepal, the Chatham
Islands and Eucla are real, and a three-quarter-usable hour is shown as one.

THE CLOCKS

Every city you add, ticking: the local time, whether it is yesterday, today or
tomorrow there, and how far ahead or behind you it is. Every row recomputes
itself every second, so land somewhere and the whole list re-reads itself
against your new zone.

SEARCHING

Type a city, not an abbreviation. Accents do not matter: sao paulo finds São
Paulo and zurich finds Zürich. Abbreviations are never an input, because they
cannot mean one zone — CST is three zones and IST is two — though the app will
show you one beside a place you chose.

The whole IANA database is in the app: every zone, every historical offset.
Nothing is fetched.

ALSO

• 12-hour or 24-hour, or follow the phone
• Compare against the phone's zone, or pin one while you are away
• Light and dark, and Material You if you want it
• Save a copy of your list to a file — this is how you move to a new phone

WHAT IT WILL NOT DO

No location, ever. Detecting which zone you are standing in is the flagship
feature of the paid rivals here and it is refused: the phone already knows its
own zone for free, and every other place on your list is one you typed.

No account, no sync, no server, and no notifications — nothing here will ever
interrupt you. Uninstalling deletes your list, and Save a copy is how you move
it.

Three permissions, all of them for the ads that keep it free.

Montenegro offers 250+ sunny days a year, the Adriatic coast, mountains and historic towns within easy reach, and a growing international community of remote workers. name: Plant Care Tracker - Ploi
description:
Ploi is a plant care tracker and plant diary for your houseplants. Log each watering and Ploi learns how often every plant really gets thirsty, then reminds you on a watering schedule that fits your home instead of a generic chart.

Watering reminders that learn

No app can know exactly how often to water a plant: light, humidity, pot size and the season all change the answer. So Ploi works it out from what you do. It looks at the last few waterings you logged, ignores the one-off gaps, and sets the next date from your real rhythm. Prefer a fixed interval for a particular plant? Switch that plant to fixed. Reminders arrive once a day, at the time you choose, as one list of everything that is due.

Reminders for the rest of your plant care

The same schedule works for fertilizing, misting, wiping leaves, repotting and pruning, and you can add care types of your own. Set a task every few days, or tie it to your waterings, such as fertilizer with every other watering.

Your plants on the home screen

Add the Ploi widget to your home screen and see what needs care without opening the app. Small sizes show what is next; the large one is a board of what is overdue, due today and due this week, with the weather where your plants live if you want it. Tap a plant and it opens. You choose what the widget shows and can write your own message for the days when everything is done.

A care log for every plant

Every watering, feeding, repotting and note goes into that plant's own timeline. One entry can hold several kinds of care, a note and photos, and you can edit it later. Long after, you can see exactly when you last fertilized, how long the plant went between waterings, or the day a new leaf opened. Watered a whole shelf? Select the plants and mark them all at once.

Growth photos and charts

Add photos to a plant or to any log entry and watch its story come together. A monstera, a snake plant or a peace lily looks different six months later, and Ploi keeps every photo. A growth chart tracks height, and a watering chart shows the gaps between waterings so you can spot the odd one out.

Rooms, weather and rain

Group plants by room, shelf or balcony, and mark each spot as indoor or outdoor. Ploi shows the weather where your plants are, and when you log rain, the next watering for outdoor plants moves back to match.

Share the care

Invite a partner, a roommate or a plant sitter. A caretaker can log waterings, notes and photos while you are away, and the history stays with the plant.

Plant care guides and identification

Look up a species in Ploi's care guides for its watering, light, toxicity and pest notes. Not sure what you have? Take a photo, identify the plant and start its care log right away.

Plant wishlist

Keep a wishlist of the plants you want next, so the ones you like are in one place for your next trip to the nursery.

Your records stay yours

Export everything, including your photos, whenever you like.

Built for people who like to keep records

When did I last water this? Is it growing? Which routine actually worked? Ploi answers all three.

Ploi Pro is an optional subscription for unlimited plants and photos and automatic rain logging.

name: Thirsty Plant: Water Reminder
description:
"I'm thirsty!" That was your monstera. And she won't stop until you water her.

Thirsty Plant is a watering reminder where your plant does the talking. Snap a photo, give it a name, pick he or she and choose its personality. From then on, the plant tells you when it needs water. All you have to do is pour.

HOW IT WORKS
• Take a photo of your plant or pick one from your gallery. It gets a cartoon face that changes with its mood: happy, thirsty, wilting.
• Find the species among 151 plants, by common or Latin name. Not on the list? Add it as "Other plant" and type its name.
• Choose where it stands and how much water it likes. You get a suggested watering interval you can change.
• A water ring around the plant slowly drains. The last 10% of the ring is your watering window.
• When it's time, an "I'm thirsty!" notification arrives and repeats every 1, 2 or 3 hours, your choice, until you water.
• "Watered!" and "Not now" work right from the notification, no need to open the app. "Not now" waits until the next reminder.
• Watering them all at once? One tap on "Water all".
• After watering, the ring fills up again and your plant thanks you.
• Leave it too long and the plant turns red and starts to wilt. Dramatic, but effective.
• See your on-time watering streak and the full watering history.

TODAY, NIGHT AND ANNIVERSARIES
• The Today tab shows who's thirsty today and what's coming up.
• Between 10 pm and 8 am your plants go to sleep and stay quiet. Nobody needs "I'm thirsty!" at midnight.
• Your plant marks its anniversaries with you: one month, six months and one year.
• Add its birthday and it gets a greeting on the day, with its age shown next to it.
• A home-screen widget shows your thirstiest plant, and one tap waters it.

A PLANT WITH A PERSONALITY
Every personality has its own lines: 50 for the day, sleepy ones for the night and special ones for anniversaries. The lines follow the plant's gender.
Three personalities come with the app: Polite, Passive-Aggressive and Dramatic.
"I see the other plants got watered. Good for them." (Passive-Aggressive)
"Desert… all around me… desert…" (Dramatic)

PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
Unlock Pro once and it's yours for good. No subscription.
• unlimited plants
• all 10 personalities: the three above plus Laid-Back Islander, Folksy Farmer, Philosopher, Sports Commentator, Star or Diva, Grumpy Grandpa or Grandma and Romantic
• photo diary: take a photo now and then and watch your plant grow, each photo with its date
• feeding reminders, together with watering from March 15 to September 30
• automatic winter schedule: from November 1 to March 31 your plants switch to their winter interval on their own
• the large widget with all your plants on the home screen
Without Pro, reminders, "Not now", the water ring, history, the Today tab, quiet nights, anniversaries and the small widget all work as usual, with one watering interval all year.

YOUR PLANTS STAY YOURS
• Works offline. The only connection is Google Play, when you buy Pro.
• No account, no sign-in.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Photos and data stay on your phone only. They aren't backed up anywhere, so uninstalling the app removes them too.
• No camera or gallery permission needed. The app uses the system camera and the system photo picker.

GET REMINDERS ON TIME
Allow notifications. If you also allow "Alarms & reminders", reminders arrive right on time. Without it, Android may delay them a little. Settings shows in one place whether everything is switched on.

Available in English, German, Italian, Slovenian and Croatian.

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

The collected observations are used to answer scientific research questions that deal, for example, with the spread of invasive species or the effects of climate change on biotopes.

In regular stories, you will learn about news from the project, get insights into the scientific work or will be made curious about what is happening in nature right now.

WHY SHOULD YOU USE FLORA INCOGNITA?
- Identify wild plants simply by taking a photo with your smartphone
- Learn more about plant species with the help of extensive plant profiles
- Collect your findings in your observation list
- Become part of an innovative scientific community
- Share your findings on Twitter, Instagram & Co!

HOW GOOD IS FLORA INCOGNITA?
Species identification with Flora Incognita is based on Deep Learning algorithms that have an accuracy of well over 90%. It is important to take sharp and as close as possible pictures of plant parts such as flower, leaf, bark or fruit for a high identification accuracy.

WOULD YOU LIKE TO LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR PROJECT?
Visit our website at www.floraincognita.com or follow us on social media. You can find us on X (@FloraIncognita2), Mastodon (@FloraIncognita@social.mpdl.mpg.de), Instagram (@flora.incognita) and Facebook (@flora.incognita).

IS THE APP REALLY FREE OF CHARGE AND ADVERTISING?
Yes. You can use Flora Incognita anytime, as long as you want. It is free to use, with no ads, no premium version and no subscription. But maybe you will enjoy searching and identifying plants so much that it will become a new hobby. We have received this feedback many times!

WHO DEVELOPED FLORA INCOGNITA?
The Flora Incognita app is developed by scientists from the Technical University of Ilmenau and the Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry Jena. Its development was supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, the German Federal Agency for Nature Conservation with funds from the German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety as well as the Thuringian Ministry for the Environment, Energy and Nature Conservation and the Foundation for Nature Conservation Thuringia. The project was awarded as an official project of the "UN Decade of Biodiversity" and won the Thuringian Research Award in 2020.

description:

1. CREATE YOUR GARDEN FROM YOUR ADDRESS
Your address is enough: Garden Connect pulls 10 years of local weather archives to know your real frost dates, and follows the forecast every day.

2. DRAW AND SET UP YOUR GARDEN
Draw your garden's outline, then its zones. Add your plants, and set the soil, exposure and watering type of each zone. The app tells you what's missing to make its recommendations more precise.

3. FOLLOW YOUR PLAN
Every day, your actions grouped by type: watering, crops, protection, harvest, care. Mark them done, the plan adjusts. Choose your goals (harvest, maintain, develop, follow) and tell the app if you garden mostly at weekends.
Behind the plan: FAO-56 water balance (the UN standard) for watering, degree-days for sowing, planting and harvest dates (based on your real planting date, with succession sowing), and epidemiological models for 270 diseases and pests.

4. TRACK YOUR GARDEN'S HEALTH
A score from 0 to 100 sums up water, weather, diseases and diversity. Soil moisture is estimated without a sensor. Monthly and yearly reports show your actions, water saved, weather records and disease risks.

Connected sprinklers and sensors (Gardena, Netatmo) add precision and automate watering.

Patch planner:

Multiple patchs:

Own varieties:
If our large selection of vegetables, fruits and herbs is not enough for you, you can also create your own special varieties. For example, take the data of a vegetable and edit it. Take your own photos of your vegetables and customize your varieties.

Pre-plan your bed on your tablet - save your planning in the cloud - with your smartphone you can wonderfully track or optimize the planning in the garden.

Three pots or thirty, a plant tracker app should fit the shelf you have. A jade that wants succulent care once a month, a fiddle-leaf fig that sulks when you are late and a balcony full of indoor plants sit side by side, each on its own plant watering schedule. Houseplant care that fits the two minutes before you leave the house. For the new plant parent with five pots and no idea what each one wants. Tweaking a recipe for the next batch? With Pro, clone it into a new version (v2, v3…) instead of overwriting your notes.

FERMENTATION LOG & ABV CALCULATOR
Add gravity and temperature readings as you take them with your hydrometer and thermometer, each with a date and an optional note, and keep the whole fermentation log for the batch in order. Move a batch from fermenting to conditioning to completed. Enter original gravity (OG) and final gravity (FG) and the ABV calculator works out alcohol by volume instantly.

TASTE, RATE, IMPROVE
Rate a finished beer from 1 to 5 and write tasting notes on aroma, mouthfeel and carbonation. The Stats tab sums up your home brewing: total batches, average rating and the beer styles you make most.

AI BREW ADVISOR
Stuck mid-ferment? The AI Brew Advisor takes the style, your gravity readings, days fermenting and taste-note chips — too bitter, watery, flat, cloudy, too sweet, gravity stalled — and returns a plain-language diagnosis with concrete adjustments for this batch and the next. It is process advice, not a sanitation guide.

FEATURES
• Beer recipe book: malt, hops, yeast, water notes, ordered brew-day steps
• Starting recipe for any style, suggested by AI and ready to edit
• Fermentation tracker with dated gravity and temperature readings
• Automatic ABV from OG and FG
• Batch status: fermenting, conditioning, completed
• Tasting ratings (1–5) and notes
• Stats: total batches, average rating, style breakdown
• Brew Advisor for troubleshooting a batch
• Light and dark themes, 10 interface languages

WHAT'S FREE
Recipes, batches and fermentation log entries are unlimited. Ratings, tasting notes and Stats are free. The Brew Advisor includes 3 free analyses, and recipe suggestions have a monthly free allowance. The free version shows banner ads.

WHAT PRO ADDS
• Unlimited Brew Advisor analyses
• Clone any recipe into a new version
• Version comparison in Stats: batches from v1 and v2 side by side
• No ads

Pro is an auto-renewing monthly or annual subscription; the price for your country is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Google Play account; cancel any time in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.

YOUR DATA
Your brewing log (recipes, batches, readings, tasting notes) is stored on your phone, with no sign-up form: the app creates an anonymous guest profile so your subscription and free allowances work. When you use an AI feature, the details you entered for that request go through our server to a third-party AI service. The app also uses Firebase (sign-in, analytics), RevenueCat (subscriptions) and Google AdMob (ads in the free version).

FOR ADULTS
Home Brewing is for adults of legal drinking age who make beer at home. It is about the craft — recipes, process and measurements. It does not track how much you drink, does not encourage drinking and makes no health claims. Sanitation and local home-brewing rules are your responsibility.

From your first extract kit to your fiftieth all-grain batch, Home Brewing keeps your beer recipes, fermentation data and tasting history in one brewing log.

description:
This app manages the Bluetooth connection from a HomeBrew HBG3/HBG4 adapter connected to a Celestron Telescope mount, with the popular SkyPortal and SkySafari apps on a smart device.

One tap sets up the connection for using the apps on the same Android device. A checkbox also enables sharing the connection across the local network (WiFi or Ethernet). Dead simple, giving a reliable Bluetooth SPP or BLE connection that works wherever "Celestron WiFi" is expected.

The app can also send GPS data to the HomeBrew device, for use by Celestron Hand-Controllers and the CPWI app.

There are also menu options to explore and modify all of the internal configuration settings, including set-up of Wi-Fi parameters, for each HomeBrew device, and to view and interact with the HomeBrew screen/menus on the Android device's screen.

The app also features extensive session logging capability, for helping debug and diagnose issues with the telescope mount and accessories.

And finally there is an easy Firmware Update feature to check, download, and install the latest HBG3/HBG4 firmware directly to the HomeBrew device. This does normally require that the Android device first be connected to a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network (not 5GHz), though some devices like newer Pixel phones may work even when on a 5GHz network.

name: Beer Carbonation Calculator
description:
Force carbonating your homemade beverage (e.g.: beer, ciders, sparkling water, sparkling wine) in your keg requires that you set the correct settings in your CO2 regulator.

This App aims to aid homebrewers in this task, by providing a list of common carbonation values, an easy to use calculator and a table of values by pressure and temperature (commonly known as a carbonation chart) where you can visually find your desired setting.

It supports imperial and metric units as well as both carbonation by volume (Volumes) and by weight (g/L).

Please note that carbonation takes time to happen and this App will only tell you what to set in your cylinder regulator, not for how long. I highly suggest that you look up the web for more information on how to force carbonate before attempting to doing so.

Follow your equipment’s instructions and pressure ratings. Use all applicable safety standards.
