Bottles are grouped by product, so three bottles of the same whiskey sit together. A compact list fits a whole shelf on one screen, or switch to cards. Mark each bottle sealed or opened, set how much is left with a slider, and add a photo and notes.

FAST TO ADD
Start typing and BarVault suggests from a built-in catalogue of more than 2,000 brands and 4,700 bottles, filling in the type, strength and country. Bottles that aren't in the catalogue are typed in freely and remembered for next time.

OPENED BOTTLES THAT DON'T LAST
Vermouth, port, sherry, cream liqueurs, wine and sake fade once opened. BarVault suggests a typical number of days after opening, which you can change, and flags bottles before they turn.

EVERY DETAIL A COLLECTOR KEEPS
Date bought, where you bought it, store pick, barrel, batch and release year. Give a product your own star rating and a "buy again?" mark, and sort by what has been on the shelf the longest. A finished bottle moves to a Finished list, and one tap puts it back on the wishlist.

A WISHLIST THAT SHOPS WITH YOU
Keep the bottles you're hunting for with the price you want to pay. In a shop, type the price and size on the label and see the price per litre and how it compares with your target. Turn on Restock and bottles running low or recently finished show up on the wishlist.

BRING YOUR SPREADSHEET
Import bottles from a CSV file saved in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets: match the columns, check the preview, then add. Export the whole collection to a CSV any time.

FIND ANY BOTTLE
Search by name or brand, even with a typo, and filter by type, opened, sealed, expiring or finished.

BACKUP YOU CONTROL
Save the whole collection to one file, see when you last saved, and restore it on a new phone. Choose replace or merge.

PRIVATE AND CALM
BarVault has no account and no server of its own. Your collection stays on your phone unless you save a backup. Warm dark and light themes. Volumes in ml, cl or fl oz. In English, Russian and Armenian.

FREE AND SUPPORTER
Everything above is free. The free app holds 5s 50 finished ones and shows a small banner ad. Supporter is a one-time purchase, no subscription, and adds: no ads, no bottle limit, a pour log with each bottle's history, collection value, a Statistics screentes, and accent colours.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

name: Home Inventory & Food: InvenDo
description:
Stop throwing away food you forgot about. InvenDo is a home inventory app for your kitchen and the rest of the house: it keeps track of what you have, where it is stored and when it expires, and reminds you in time.

Scan a barcode or type a name, put the item in a storage place (fridge, freezer, pantry, garage, bathroom cabinet), and you always know what is in the house without going to look.

STOP THROWING FOOD AWAY
- Nothing spoils at the back of the fridge again: give an item an expiry date and it is flagged as Expires soon, then Already expired
- A reminder arrives at the time of day you choose, so you use things while they are still good
- Opened a jar or a pack? Mark it opened, and InvenDo sets a Consume by date from the shelf life you enter once, then remembers it for next time

NEVER RUN OUT OF WHAT YOU ALWAYS NEED
- Coffee, diapers, cat food: set a Minimum quantity and InvenDo tells you before the last one is gone
- Everything below its minimum sits on one screen, ready to go onto the shopping list
- Set the minimum for a whole category, not just item by item

BUY ONLY WHAT IS MISSING
- A shopping list built from what your pantry actually lacks, instead of from memory
- Group the list by store, so one trip covers one shop
- Check things off in the aisle, then move what you bought straight into your inventory
- Send the grocery list to whoever is going out, as plain text

ADD THINGS IN SECONDS
- Scan a barcode to add an item, scan again to take one away
- A scanned barcode can fill in the product name and photo for you (available in many countries, not all)
- Start typing and InvenDo suggests things you have had before

FIND ANYTHING WITHOUT SEARCHING THE HOUSE
- Storage places inside storage places: the freezer, then the top drawer
- Categories with colors, and subcategories when you need them
- Photos of your items and your storage places, and an icon for each storage place
- Unit sizes that add up for you: 1 pack = 6 pcs, or 1 pack = 250 g, with the total on hand
- Search your whole home inventory by name or by voice

KEEP THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD IN SYNC
- Invite your partner, children or roommates by email, and everyone sees the same list as it changes
- Keep several lists (home, parents' house, a hobby collection) and choose who sees which
- People you invite get the paid features on your shared list at no extra cost
- Works offline, syncs when you are back online
- Check the shopping list off from an Android home screen widget, or open your inventory in a browser at web.invendo.app
- Export to Excel whenever you like, or import a spreadsheet you already keep

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who wants a pantry inventory that is actually up to date. Food in the fridge, freezer and pantry. Medicines and their shelf life. Cosmetics. Clothes you forget you own. Tools in the garage. Hobby collections. Wine, spices, camping gear, baby supplies, printer cartridges. It is built for a household rather than a business, and it is simple enough that the rest of the family will actually use it.

NO ADS, AND A GENEROUS FREE VERSION
The inventory, storage places, categories, the shopping list, barcode scanning, expiry and low-quantity reminders, Excel export, sharing the list, the widget and sync across devices are all free, and there are no ads anywhere in the app. Premium adds photos, storage icons, Excel import, deeper subcategories, extra lists, inviting other people, filling the shopping list from low-quantity items in one tap, and the web app. Take it monthly, yearly, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase: pay once and use it forever.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@invendo.app, a real person answers, usually within a day.
Guides and answers: https://help.invendo.app
More about InvenDo: https://invendo.app

name: My Bar: Home Cocktails
description:
What can you make with the ingredients you already have? My Bar helps you find out. Mark the bottles and ingredients in your home bar, then discover the cocktails you can prepare. Explore the included catalog of 384 recipes and 297 ingredients, even offline.

Start with your home bar
• See which cocktails are ready to make.
• Find recipes missing just one or two ingredients.
• Search, filter by tags and save your favorites. Browse in a list or a grid.
• Follow ingredient quantities and preparation steps in one place.

Shop and plan with purpose
• Add missing ingredients to your shopping list.
• See which ingredients let you make more recipes, so you can decide what to buy next.
• Scale recipe quantities to your chosen number of servings. Use ml, cl or fl oz.
• In party mode, choose cocktails and servings to create one combined ingredient list.

Make it your own
• Tap Surprise Me when you want a new idea.
• Create and edit your own cocktails and ingredients.
• Import and export your catalog as a JSON file.

Available in 13 languages
The interface and included recipes support English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German, French, Italian, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi and Arabic. Change the language in the app whenever you like.

My Bar is free to use, with no account required. Your home bar selections and preferences stay on your device. The included recipes and core features work without an internet connection, from checking your ingredients to calculating quantities for your next gathering.

name: Cocktails & Home Bar - Topa!
description:
Turn the bottles you already own into cocktails you can make tonight.

Topa! is your home bar, cocktail recipe book, and mixology toolkit in one. Scan your bottles and ingredients, and Topa! instantly shows you what you can make right now, what you're closest to making next, and which bottles will unlock more cocktails for your bar.

Whether you're building your first home bar or perfecting your favorite craft cocktails, Topa! helps you make more with what you have and shop smarter for what you don't.

FIND COCKTAILS BY WHAT YOU HAVE
• Scan your bar and Topa! recognizes your bottles automatically.
• See cocktail recipes you can make right now, based on what's actually in your bar.
• Discover cocktails you're only one bottle or ingredient away from making.
• See which bottles will unlock more cocktails, so you know what's worth adding to your bar next.

YOUR ENTIRE HOME BAR, IN ONE PLACE
• Track bottles, spirits, syrups, bitters, ingredients, glassware, and bar tools.
• Add anything by photo, search, or voice.
• See what you have and what you're running low on without digging through your shelves.

CURATED COCKTAIL RECIPES, ADDED WEEKLY
• Explore a growing collection of classics, modern favorites, craft cocktails, mocktails, and more.
• Every recipe is curated by Topa!, not scraped from the web.
• Follow step-by-step recipes with exact measurements, glassware, and garnishes.
• Switch between oz and ml, scale servings, and see every ingredient you're missing.
• Save your favorites and customize recipes to make them your own.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
Found a cocktail you want to try? Bring it straight into your bar.

• Paste a recipe link from the web.
• Import recipe text from a blog, TikTok, or Instagram.
• Scan a recipe from a photo or screenshot.
• Turn it into a clean, editable recipe saved to your Topa! library.

GO BEYOND THE RECIPE
Learn the techniques behind better cocktails and put them to work with tools built for home bartenders.

TOPA! PRO
Take your home bar further:
• Build your bar without limits: add unlimited bottles, ingredients, glassware, and bar tools.
• Save as many cocktail recipes as you want and keep your entire library at hand.
• Scan bottles and recipes without limits, and add bottles hands-free with voice.
• Scale recipes without limits, from a single cocktail to a full party in seconds.
• Fine-tune dilution when scaling recipes, so your batches are ready to pour and enjoy.
• Refine and perfect your drinks with intelligent cocktail insights.
• Batch cocktails for the freezer with dilution calculations built in.

From your first Margarita to your next clarified milk punch, Topa! helps you discover better cocktails, learn the craft, and make more with the bottles already in your bar.

Cheers. Topa!

—

Topa Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Pricing varies by region and is shown before purchase. Cancel anytime.

Terms of Use: https://www.gettopa.app/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.gettopa.app/privacy-policy

name: Home Bar Hero
description:
Your home bar, unlocked. Spirits and Wine.

Home Bar Hero turns the bottles you already own into a cocktail menu. Snap a photo or search, and every bottle you add reveals new drinks you can actually make tonight.

BUILD YOUR BAR
Stock your bar in seconds. Take one photo of your shelf and AI identifies up to 10 bottles at once, then paints each one as art, so the bar in the app looks like the bar in your kitchen. Duplicate bottles stack with a count, and you can long press to arrange the shelf the way it actually sits at home.

THE CELLAR: A PLACE FOR YOUR WINE
Scan a wine bottle and the app reads the producer, the varietal, the region, and the year off the label, because for wine the vintage is part of which bottle it is. Your wine lands in the Cellar rather than on the spirits shelf, racked by when it wants to be opened. Tap a bottle and it flips over to a researched back label: what it tastes like, what to eat with it, and the window when it drinks best. Ask what to open tonight and the answer comes from your own rack.

DISCOVER WHAT TO MAKE
Your bar is matched against hundreds of recipes, classics plus seasonal drops, growing every month as members share their own. See what you can pour right now, what you are one bottle away from, and the near misses tagged "Ready, with a sub" with the swap that works. Smart Buy names the single bottle that unlocks the most new drinks on your shelf.

THE BARKEEP, YOUR AI BARTENDER
Chatting with the Barkeep is free on every account. It reads your actual inventory, so it only suggests drinks you can make. It writes the complete recipe right in the chat, measurements and method and glass and garnish, with one tap to save. It checks real published recipes when you want the canonical version of a classic, reads photos of bottles and menus, remembers the conversation, and can stock a bottle for you without you leaving the chat.

THE OPEN BAR
One room every member shares, not a feed. Read the conversation, the tasting notes, the threads, and the Barkeep answering out loud, free on any account. Lurking is welcome. Top Shelf supporters pull up a stool and post.

SHARE YOUR BAR
Friends pull up a stool at your bar as Regulars and see the recipes you choose to share. Every recipe is private by default and you pick the audience per drink. Build drink menus and your guests browse them from one QR code, no app and no login needed. Earn badges as you go.

MORE OF WHAT IT DOES
Flavor Lab: dial in a taste with sliders and the app invents a complete, balanced cocktail, using only your own bottles if you like.
Menu scanner: photograph a restaurant drink list and get the drinks back as real recipes.
Recipe packs: a themed drop of drinks you flip through, save, and make, with more on the way.
Cocktail history: origin stories for the classics.
Export your bar as a spreadsheet, because your bar is yours.
A dark theme built for evening use.

FREE TO START, FAIR FOREVER
No ads. The free tier is a real bar, not a demo: bottle scanning, recipe matching, free chat with the Barkeep, daily AI credits, painted shelf art, saved recipes, badges, a shareable drink menu, and the whole Open Bar to read. The optional Top Shelf upgrade adds a bigger daily AI allowance, your whole bar and cellar painted, as many drink menus as you want, the party hosting tools, and a stool in the Open Bar. Top Shelf is how supporters keep the app running for everybody else.

Whether you are a seasoned mixologist or just getting started, Home Bar Hero helps you make better drinks with what you already have.

Please enjoy responsibly. Home Bar Hero is for adults of legal drinking age.

name: Home Inventory by AllKeep
description:
Photograph what you own and AllKeep fills in the item for you: its name, category, and the brand and model when it can read them. Put things in rooms and boxes, print QR labels for the boxes, and share the whole home with your family.

When you need something, search or ask in plain words ("winter boots", "the lease from 2022") and AllKeep tells you which box it is in. When your insurer asks for a list after a fire, a flood or a theft, the web app prints every item with its photo, place and value, or saves it as a PDF or a spreadsheet.

WHAT'S IN IT

• AI from a photo. One photo per item, or lay several things on a table and add them all from one shot.
• Rooms and boxes, nested the way you store things: a box on a shelf in a room.
• QR labels. Stick one on a box and scan it to see what is inside.
• Ask (Pro). Questions in plain words about everything you own.
• Up to 10 photos per item: front, back, serial number, receipt.
• Family sharing and separate workspaces: your home, your parents' home, a storage unit.
• Works offline and syncs when you are back online.
• The same inventory on the web at allkeep.org.
• Export any time: a CSV and a printable report on the web, JSON in the app.

PRIVACY

Your photos and notes stay in your account. There are no ads, and we sell nothing to anyone. Photos sent to OpenAI for recognition are processed on request and not used to train models. Full policy: https://allkeep.org/en/privacy

PRICING

Items, boxes, rooms, sharing, QR labels and search are free with no time limit, and every account gets 30 AI credits a month. Pro unlocks unlimited AI recognition and Ask. Google Play shows the price before you subscribe, and you can cancel any time in Google Play.

name: CocktailVault: Home Bar
description:
CocktailVault is the smart home bar companion built for people who take their cocktails seriously.

Scan your bottles with AI, discover what you can make tonight, and print a stunning bar menu to impress your guests. Pay once. Own it forever. No subscription. Ever.

SCAN & BUILD YOUR BAR
Point your camera at any spirit bottle and let AI identify it instantly. No more manual typing.

KNOW WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
CocktailVault analyzes your entire bar in real time. Every recipe is ranked by what you have on hand — so you always know your options before you open a bottle. Smart substitution suggestions mean a missing ingredient rarely has to stop you.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT BOTTLE
The Next Best Buy tab shows you which single bottle would unlock the most new recipes. Stop guessing at the liquor store and start building a bar with purpose.

PRINT A PROFESSIONAL BAR MENU
Generate a stunning bar menu from your makeable recipes with a single tap. Customize the title, subtitle, and drinks — then print or share a polished PDF your guests will remember.

AI BARTENDER
Ask anything. Get cocktail recommendations based on your exact inventory, learn techniques, explore flavor pairings, and discover new drinks — all from a conversational AI bartender trained on classic and modern cocktail knowledge.

YOUR DATA, EVERYWHERE
Cloud sync keeps your bar inventory and favorites in sync across all your devices. Log in and your bar travels with you.

BUILT FOR ENTHUSIASTS
- 200+ classic and modern cocktail recipes
- Smart ingredient substitution
- AI bottle scanning — identify any spirit instantly
- Favorite, hide, and edit recipes to curate your collection
- Generate and print a custom PDF bar menu
- Cocktail education built in — learn techniques as you go

ONE-TIME PURCHASE. NO SUBSCRIPTION. EVER.
$9.99 gets you the full app with 75 AI credits included — enough to scan your bar, explore recipes, and chat with your AI bartender. Additional AI credits are available for purchase if you want more, but they exist only to cover the real cost of AI processing. Everything else in the app is yours forever.

Developed by Texas Ridge Labs.

name: Magic Home Inventory
description:
This is a home inventory application.
It helps you maintain a list of stuff you have, with an efficient interface and easy navigation. The inventory structure is based on real life. There are 3 types of belongings: properties have rooms (or areas) and items located within. Container items, like boxes, can contain any other items. You can create lists of items, just like you could on a piece of paper. See Structure section in Help for more details.

Features:
 • Infinite hierarchy: Property ▶ Room ▶ Item ▶ Item ▶ …
 • Categories: 15 diverse categories with 300+ well-defined finer categories
 • Categorization aid based on 2,500+ hand-selected keywords
 • Custom camera to help selecting the item on the picture
 • Move selection of items into any container
 • Advanced search to easily find anything in moments
 • Sunburst chart to see a visual overview of your stuff
 • Import/Export to manually backup or transfer your inventory

When is it useful?
 • You have a remote storage and you don't remember exactly what's there.
 • You're moving, to remember which box contains what.
 • You're tidy and organized and want to know where your stuff belongs.
 • You want to inventory valuable items for insurance purposes.
 • You're not at home, but your family member/flatmate wants something.
 • You want to declutter, you can create a list of stuff you want to throw away.
 • You're transitioning to a minimalist lifestyle and want to share your redundant stuff up for grabs.
 • You're curious how many pens you have lying around the house.

If you're stuck take a look at the Help inside the app.
If you have any question or comment feel free to send a feedback email, I'll answer them.
Please send the error reports if they pop up. The app doesn't have Internet permission, so it can't send automatic crash reports.

Category suggestions are currently available in English only (Hungarian on the way); translators wanted for other languages!

name: Home Inventory App
description:
* Home Inventory App is a private, offline way to catalog everything you own.
* Record your belongings, photos, serial numbers, receipts and values.

* An ideal home asset manager

Your data never leaves your device:
- No account,

📦 CATALOG EVERYTHING YOU OWN
- 30+ fields per item: name, brand, model, serial number, color, size, condition, purchase price, estimated value, purchase date, notes and unlimited custom fields
- Attach photos and documents such as receipts and manuals
- Organize by room and by household member
- 14 built-in categories with 100+ subcategories, or create your own

🔍 FIND ANYTHING INSTANTLY
- Full-text search across every field
- Filter by room, occupant, category, value range and warranty status
- Sort by name, price, date or category

🔔 WARRANTY TRACKER WITH REMINDERS
- Track warranty start and expiry dates for every item

Create detailed home inventory reports by room, occupant or category, with every photo, serial number and value. Ideal for insurance claims, estate planning and moving day.

- Export your inventory to CSV and import existing spreadsheets
- Encrypted ZIP backups of your database, photos and documents

Upgrade to unlock:

Download Home Inventory App and finally know what you own, where it is and what it's worth, without handing your data to anyone.

name: BarScan: Bar Inventory
description:
BarScan turns a stock count into a few minutes of photos. Point your phone at a bottle, a crate or a delivery invoice. BarScan reads what it is and how much is left, and adds it to your inventory.

Made for bars, cafés, restaurants, hotels and groups with several venues. It works offline, so you can count the cellar or the storeroom without signal.

FOUR WAYS TO SCAN
• Liquid scan: photograph an opened bottle where it stands. AI reads the label, you set the liquid line, and BarScan works out what is left.
• Item scan: cans, bags and single products, identified from the label.
• Box scan: one photo of a crate, box or pile and one of its label. Every piece is counted together.
• Invoice scan: photograph a delivery invoice or upload a PDF, and incoming stock goes straight into inventory.

END-OF-SHIFT, SORTED
• Daily report with opening, used and closing stock for every item
• See what was poured, what is left and what to restock
• Export as PDF, or CSV on Growth and Enterprise plans
• Scheduled reports sent to you by email

BUILT FOR YOUR TEAM
• Owner, Manager and Teammate roles
• Every stock change records who made it, visible to Owners and Managers
• Add staff by email. They do not need their own subscription

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
• Scans and adjustments are saved on the phone and sync when you are back online

SEE WHAT IT SAVES
• Each item takes about 5 seconds instead of 30. The built-in calculator shows the hours and payroll your team keeps.

PLANS
You need a subscription to create a venue. Managers and Teammates you add do not pay.
• Starter: 1 venue, up to 5 team seats, PDF reports
• Growth: up to 5 venues, unlimited seats, PDF and CSV reports
• Enterprise: unlimited venues and seats, priority support with a named contact
Scans are unlimited on every plan. If a free trial is offered, its length is shown before you subscribe. You can cancel at any time in Google Play.

Terms of Service: https://barscan.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://barscan.app/privacy

BarScan is an inventory tool for hospitality businesses. It does not sell alcohol.

name: Itemtopia Home Inventory
description:
Itemtopia is a home inventory app for Android, used by people in 100+ countries for over 10 years. Track everything you own, including items, receipts, warranties, service records, and documents, all in one private, searchable place.

Itemtopia is best for anyone who wants a complete home inventory for insurance documentation, moving, downsizing, or estate planning. It goes beyond basic item tracking to store receipts, warranty expiry reminders, service notes, and renewal reminders alongside every item.

FREE TO TRY — UP TO 20 ITEMS
Download and explore everything Itemtopia can do with up to 20 items. No credit card required. When you're ready to track your whole inventory, upgrade to Premium for unlimited items and the full feature set.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Track items room by room with photos and details. Store receipts and get reminders before warranties expire. Search everything instantly by name, photo, or barcode scan. Forward email receipts to automatically create items. Ask the AI assistant questions about your items or their current value. Export insurance claim and estate reports as PDF or CSV. Share access with a partner, housemate, or anyone else using the Add User feature, with their own secure login.

PREMIUM — UNLIMITED EVERYTHING
Unlimited items and 2GB of attachment storage
Insurance claim and estate reports as PDF or CSV
Custom categories and fields
Multi-user access with permission controls, each person with their own secure login
QR label creation and scanning
AI assistance for item questions

Premium pricing is available inside the app. Options vary by country.

RECOGNIZED BY
NerdWallet, Fox News, Make Tech Easier, Good Cover, AARP, and AppAdvice.

PRIVATE AND SECURE
Your data is encrypted end to end. Works fully offline too.

name: CoT: Home Inventory
description:
Club of Things is a home inventory app for cataloging what you own and deciding what to keep private, share, lend, or give away. Build a useful record of your home, workshop, books, tools, electronics, and collections, then share selected items or collections with family, friends, neighbors, or groups.

Key Features:

Inventory that stays useful

Share, Lend & Give Away

Offline & Private

AI & AI Assistant Access

Useful For:
Home inventory, insurance documentation, tool and workshop organization, family collections, neighborhood sharing, lending items to friends, giving away unused things, warranty tracking, moving, downsizing, collectibles, books, electronics, and small business assets.

Club of Things has no subscription requirement and is built for real personal inventory workflows, from private records to shared catalogs.

Download Club of Things and organize what you own.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

With the Power Expansion (in-app purchase):

With the Challenges expansion (in-app purchase):

- Ongoing Reach your next H-index challenges.
- Set the time period and choose specific games to track, or use auto-fill.
- Filter specific Players, Locations and player counts to count for the challenge.

With a Cloud sync subscription:

Please note that any changes to the BGG website or API can temporarily break BGG related features. I cannot guarantee their continued availability.

Collaborate seamlessly with your team members or friends and family with direct integration with our Cloud drive for sending and receiving encrypted files.

MEGA offers generous free storage for all registered users. You can get even more free storage in 5 GB increments through our MEGA Achievements Programme.

description:

Every tool is free with up to 7 owned unsold inventory items. No Haulfolio account required. Each quantity unit counts, including archived unsold items. Sold and disposed items free a space. Upgrade only when you need unlimited inventory.

Organize every find
Save photos, brand, size, condition, source, SKU, storage location and target price. Add multiple units with per-unit or total costs, or split a purchase lot across its items. Find unlisted stock and save filters for older inventory. Scan a UPC or EAN barcode, or type it manually; you add the item's title, condition and cost yourself.

Research before buying
Search current eBay listings by item name or barcode in the installed app. Compare photos and asking prices; shipping and taxes may be extra. Open sold-listing searches in your browser to research past sales. Asking prices are not sold prices or valuations. Enter your own costs and fees in the calculator to estimate profit, margin, return on cost and break-even. Estimates exclude buyer tax, overhead and future returns.

Import your own eBay records
Optionally connect your eBay account to review and import your listings and sales. Match existing stock or add reviewed units, including their purchase costs and dates. Historical sold items do not use the free inventory allowance. Imports run when you choose; Haulfolio does not publish or edit eBay listings or continuously sync your account.

Keep sales and returns connected
Record sale price, shipping collected, fees, postage and packaging. See item profit after those costs and purchase cost. Buyer tax is separate from revenue. Log refunds, fee credits and return postage; mark returns sellable or damaged. Choose report periods and compare item profit by channel, category or source. Comparisons exclude overhead and unsold losses; total reports include them separately.

Bring your spreadsheet
Import inventory and historical sales from CSV. Match columns and preview quantities, costs and sale details before saving. New unsold units must fit your allowance. Export CSV records or make a full backup with records and photos. Full restore replaces the selected workspace; CSV exports are not full backups. Existing records and restored history remain accessible above the free allowance.

Log business mileage
Record a trip's date, purpose, distance and optional route notes. Keep miles and kilometres separate and export your log. Distances are entered manually; there is no GPS tracking or automatic tax-deduction calculation.

Make it your workspace
Answer optional setup questions and choose a useful starting point. Select one of 23 currencies before financial records lock the choice. There is no currency conversion. Core records work offline and stay on your device unless exported or included in device backups. There is no automatic app cloud sync. eBay features and purchases need internet.

Optional Haulfolio Pro
Pro adds unlimited owned unsold inventory. Every other tool is included free. US reference prices are $4.99/month or $39.99/year, each with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. After the trial, your plan is charged and renews automatically unless canceled in Google Play. Google Play confirms eligibility, local price and billing period before purchase. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid the first charge. Existing records remain accessible when Pro ends. Restore purchases restores subscription access, not inventory data.

description:

Whether you've inherited a jar of old quarters or carefully collected key dates for years, PriceGuide gives you accurate, up-to-date prices for every grade — instantly. Open the app, find the coin, see the value. No collection to set up, no account to create.

FEATURES

• Every major U.S. coin series — from Indian Head Cents to Morgan Dollars to Saint-Gaudens Double Eagles
• Pricing for every grade, mint mark, proof, specimen, variety, and error
• Live precious-metal melt values for every silver, gold, and copper coin — from real-time spot prices

• Live eBay listings to see what your coins are actually selling for
• Series Info pages with the story behind every coin design
• Composition + historical melt chart for any coin, with selectable time ranges
• Full Canadian coverage in addition to U.S.

JUNK SILVER & MELT CALCULATOR

The Metals tab shows current silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices alongside the melt value of popular coins:
• 90% silver dimes, quarters, halves, and dollars
• 40% silver Kennedy halves (1965–1970)
• War nickels (1942–1945)
• American Silver Eagles
• Pre-1933 gold ($2.50 / $5 / $10 / $20)
• American Gold Eagles and Gold Buffalos
• Pre-1982 Lincoln cents and large copper coinage

Tap any coin or spot price to see composition, weight, per-metal value, and a melt-value chart you can scrub through.

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS FOR

• Looking up what a coin is worth before selling
• Checking key date premiums (1909-S VDB, 1916-D Mercury, 1893-S Morgan) at a glance
• Estimating melt value on junk silver, war nickels, pre-1933 gold, and copper cents
• Verifying mintage and rarity before bidding on eBay
• Pricing inherited coin collections without a dealer visit

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS NOT

PriceGuide is a price reference, not a collection tracker. To catalog the coins you own — grades, purchase prices, completion progress, portfolio value — use our sibling app LuckyCoin. PriceGuide is for the moment you just need to know "what is this worth, right now."

PRICEGUIDE PREMIUM

Unlock the full app:
• Pricing for every grade (free tier shows two)
• Live spot prices on the Metals tab (free tier shows a one-week-old snapshot)
• Proof and specimen pricing
• Variety and error pricing
• Pricing for Proof Sets and Mint Sets

Subscribe monthly or yearly, or unlock everything once with a Lifetime purchase. Cancel anytime in Settings.

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Q: How accurate are the prices?
A: The database refreshes regularly from auction and dealer data. Actual sale prices vary by grade, eye appeal, and certification.

Q: Does PriceGuide track my collection?
A: No — it's a price lookup reference. For collection tracking, use LuckyCoin.

Q: Are melt values accurate?
A: Yes. Calculated from real-time silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices using each coin's actual composition and weight.

Q: Free or paid?
A: Free with two grade points per coin. Premium unlocks every grade, varieties, errors, proofs, and live melt values.

Q: Privacy?
A: No account required. We don't track your lookups or sell your data.

Made by Stuck at Home, LLC — also behind LuckyCoin (coin tracker), LuckyFind (metal detecting log), LuckyVinyl (records), and the Lucky family of utility and collector apps.

name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

name: Recipe Scale: Cooking Scaler
developer: BORBE CAD(COMPUTER AIDED DESIGN) SERVICES LIMITED
description:
Recipe Scale: Cooking Scaler helps you adjust your own recipes when you need a different number of servings, want to use another pan size, or only have a certain amount of an ingredient available.

Save a recipe once and rescale its ingredient amounts whenever your plans change. Scale by servings, pieces, slices, or finished weight; choose an ingredient and enter the amount you currently have; or adjust a recipe for round, square, and rectangular pans. The app shows the calculated multiplier together with the original and updated quantities so changes remain easy to review.

Common kitchen measurements are formatted in practical increments, while supported metric and US units can be converted across a recipe. Weight and volume conversions use stored ingredient-density information where applicable.

Recipe Scale also includes tools for estimating ingredient costs and cost per serving, working with baker's percentages, adjusting dough hydration, and following a recipe in a step-by-step cooking view. Multiple timers can be used during preparation, and the screen can remain awake while Cooking Mode is active.

Recipes can also be added from pasted text and edited afterward. A built-in unit converter supports common cooking measurements and temperatures, including Celsius, Fahrenheit, and gas marks. Ingredients from one or several recipes can be combined into a shopping list to make preparation easier.

Recipe calculations are intended as practical cooking aids. Weight-to-volume conversions can vary between ingredients and products, and pan-size or baking-time guidance should be treated as a reference rather than a guarantee.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Change the servings and see every ingredient scaled at once. Spoons and cups use friendly fractions (1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 3/4); grams and millilitres stay practical.
• Scale from one ingredient: tell the app you only have 300 g of flour and the rest follows.
• Convert between teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, fluid ounces, millilitres and litres, and between grams, kilograms, ounces and pounds.
• Convert between volume and weight only when you enter the density of the ingredient yourself.

GOOD TO KNOW
Baking times, temperatures and pan sizes do not scale automatically. Check them yourself.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works fully offline. The app has no network access.
• No account, no sign-in, no ads and no analytics.
• Everything you enter stays on your device. Uninstalling the app or choosing Delete all data in Settings removes it.

name: ScaleChef — Recipe Scaler
description:
ScaleChef — Recipe Scaler & Kitchen Converter

Cooking for two when the recipe serves six? Doubling a batch for guests? ScaleChef does the kitchen math for you — and it all works offline, with no account and no ads.

SCALE A RECIPE LIVE
Save a recipe with its ingredient list and original serving count, then just tap the servings up or down. Every quantity rescales instantly, written the way you'd actually measure it — "1 1/2 cups", not "1.4732". No more scribbling on the back of an envelope.

MEASURE BY WEIGHT WHEN IT MATTERS
For baking staples like flour, sugar, and butter, ScaleChef shows a gram estimate next to the cup measurement, so you can switch to a scale for the ingredients where precision counts.

SWITCH BETWEEN US AND METRIC
Flip a whole recipe between US cups/ounces and metric millilitres/grams. ScaleChef picks sensible units for each ingredient automatically instead of leaving you with "0.95 litres".

QUICK CONVERT
Need a one-off answer? Pick a from-unit and a to-unit, type a number, done. Volume and weight, US and metric — plus an optional ingredient-weight estimate.

OVEN & PANS
• Convert oven temperatures between °F and °C, with the matching UK gas mark
• Find a substitute baking pan — ScaleChef ranks your other pans by how closely they match, and tells you how much to scale the recipe to fit

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No login, no internet connection, no ads. Every recipe you save stays on your device. Set your preferred units once and start cooking.

• Adaptive nutrition coach: smart algorithms personalize your calorie and macro intake targets, just like a nutrition coach would, and weekly check-ins keep you on track

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set your goal (lose, maintain, or gain) and choose your rate of weight change to set your calorie deficit or surplus.

2. Log your meals in the food log and weigh in with the weight tracker as usual.

3. Each week, MacroFactor compares your calorie and macro intake with your weight trend to calculate your true energy expenditure (TDEE) and detect changes in your metabolism.

4. It then adjusts your calorie, protein, and macro targets for the week ahead, so your diet plan keeps working and you avoid a plateau.

FAQ

• How does MacroFactor set my calorie target?

It estimates your energy expenditure from your food logs and weight trend, then adjusts your targets at each weekly check-in.

• What if I go over my targets or skip logging?

Nothing breaks. The algorithm is adherence neutral, so your check-in and calorie adjustment still work, with no warnings or red numbers.

• Can I set my own macros instead of following the coach?

Yes. Choose Manual mode, and set different macros for different days.

• How can I log food quickly?

Snap a photo with AI food logging, describe your meal, speak it, or scan a barcode or nutrition label.

description:
Jotbook is a digital bullet journal you can also use for tasks, a diary, and habit tracking. Open and write: jot down a task, an event, or a thought in one short line, move unfinished things forward, and keep it all by day, week, month, and year — like a paper notebook, without a pile of overdue alerts.

WRITE IN SECONDS
Open the app and you are on today’s page. A symbol plus one short line is enough; press return and start the next. No forms, no folders.
• Tasks: things to do — check them off, move them, set them for a later month, or cross them out
• Events: what happened or will happen — meetings, dates, little moments
• Notes: ideas, reminders, anything you don’t want to forget
Type -, o, !, or * to switch the type or add a highlight as you write. Add #tags in the line itself; tap a tag to see everything on that topic. Break a big item into smaller ones. Pick the symbols you like, or tap them above the keyboard.

DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR
Flip through your life the way a paper journal does, without being chased by due dates:
• Daily: one page per day; swipe to change dates. Yesterday’s unfinished tasks show up quietly at the top
• Weekly: the week’s focus, with each day beside it
• Monthly: this month’s list and a look back; things you set for a month reappear when that month arrives
• Yearly: what you want this year, with a month-by-month view
Unfinished tasks can move to another day, a future month, or your own list. Tidying replaces nagging; if something keeps getting moved, Jotbook asks whether it is still worth doing.

YOUR OWN LISTS, PLUS SEARCH
Books, shopping, travel, projects, wishlists — make your own pages, written the same way as your journal.
Everything lives in a simple table of contents. Search any line and jump straight to it.

HABITS
Build a habit or quit one. Count times, or time yourself.
Every day, weekdays, or a few times a week; reminders are optional.
See progress by day, week, month, and year — a year view, streaks, and how often you followed through.
Shrink the timer, tap to pause, hold to stop, and stay on the page.

QUIET AND SIMPLE
It looks like paper. Light or dark, and you choose which day the week starts on.
Optional evening reminders: one minute to look back on today.

WHO IT’S FOR
If you keep a paper bullet journal and want the same way of writing on your phone; if to-do and calendar apps feel too loud; if you want a diary, a planner, and habit tracking in one notebook — Jotbook is for that.

Start writing with Jotbook today.

WHAT'S INSIDE

WHY A GUIDED JOURNAL

A blank page is the hardest part of keeping a diary. A guided journal with writing prompts gives every entry a starting point, so reflection happens even on the days when you have nothing to say. Dedicate five minutes and the practice becomes a routine that supports personal growth, so you can focus on what matters: understanding your inner self.

SHADOW WORK AND INTROSPECTION

Shadow work is the part of journaling that asks about the things you normally steer around. Prompted approaches it the same way it approaches everything else — with a question rather than a blank page. Use the introspective prompts to explore the parts of yourself you tend not to write about, and pair them with mood check-ins and gratitude entries so the practice stays balanced. A shadow work journal only works if you actually open it, which is what the daily question is for.

FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE BOUNCED OFF JOURNALING

If you have downloaded a journal app before, written twice and stopped, the problem was probably never discipline — it was the empty screen. A daily question removes the hardest decision. Answer it, close the app, come back tomorrow. That is the whole loop, and it is why a guided diary survives ordinary weeks when a blank one does not.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Entries live behind a biometric lock, and your diary stores its entries in local app storage on your device. No account is required: there is no sign-up and no email address to hand over.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a PDF or a CSV through your device's share controls. PDF export is quota-limited on the free tier; premium removes the limit.

FREE AND PREMIUM

Prompted is free to download and the daily practice is free to use. Premium opens the rest of the prompt catalog and lifts the export quota. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY WRITING PRACTICE

Some people keep Prompted as a self care diary, some as a shadow work journal, some as a reflection app, some as a plain daily record with a question attached. The prompt is the point: it makes the practice repeatable on the ordinary days, which are most of them.

Download Prompted and start today — a private diary with guided prompts for reflection, shadow work and growth.

name: Three Good Things - Gratitude
description:
Three Good Things is a simple gratitude journal for the end of the day — a private daily gratitude diary for positivity, mood and calm.

Every evening, write down three good things that happened and how each one made you feel. That is the whole practice. Write them, then put the phone down.

Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology.

WHAT THE APP DOES

- Three good things a day. Short entries, not essays.
- The "I felt" prompt. After each good thing, note the feeling that came with it.
- Memories. Re-read past entries and watch your good days collect over months and years.
- A daily reminder at a time you choose.
- A quote each day.
- Themes, including a night mode for reading in bed.
- Works as a mood diary too: the feelings you note build a quiet record of your moods over the months.

A JOURNAL APP THAT ASKS FOR LESS

Most journal apps hand you a blank page and a cursor. This one asks the same question every evening, so a diary entry is finished in the time it takes to make tea. If you have looked for a free journal app, a gratitude diary or a daily writing habit and bounced off the effort, that is the gap this gratitude app is built for.

PRIVACY

- No account is required. There is no sign-up, and no email address to hand over.
- Journal entries are stored locally in app storage. Exporting or sharing creates a copy through your device's share controls.
- No ads. No AI.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a CSV that can be imported later, or a PDF readable archive. Premium includes unlimited exports; the free app includes three.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The daily practice is free. Premium adds decorative themes and a polished PDF keepsake. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY GRATITUDE HABIT

Three short entries make a five minute gratitude practice. Done nightly, the gratitude journal becomes a daily habit of noticing — a small act of self care before bed. Some people keep it alongside a longer diary or a mood tracker; this one only ever asks for the good things, so being grateful stays easy.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

The three good things exercise asks you to name three things that went well and your part in them. It has been studied in positive psychology as a gratitude exercise, and it is deliberately small: the point is that it is easy enough to do on an ordinary evening, in the ordinary mood you happen to be in.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who have started a journal before and stopped. If a blank page has ever felt like homework, this daily gratitude diary asks for a good deal less: three good things, a feeling for each, done.

Download Three Good Things and start your gratitude journal tonight — a simple daily journaling practice for a more grateful evening.

name: Calluna: Gratitude Journal
developer: La Boîte à Rêves - The Dream Box - Bedtime stories
description:
An annoyance stays with you all day. A small good thing fades in ten minutes. Calluna exists to correct that imbalance.

Every evening, you write down three good things from your day. Even tiny ones. Even "silly" ones. Two minutes, no more. It's the Three Good Things exercise from psychologist Martin Seligman, one of the most studied in positive psychology — and the heart of your gratitude journal.

Except here, your good things don't pile up in a list you never reopen. Each one opens a flower, and your plant for the month grows with you: seed, sprout, young plant, flowering shrub, majestic tree. On the last day of the month it joins your garden for good. Twelve months, twelve plants, a whole year you can take in at a glance.

It's a gratitude journal you can watch grow. That's why the habit sticks — and why Calluna works as a self-care diary rather than one more app you forget.


🌱 YOUR EVENING RITUAL

• Three good things, in two minutes flat
• Your mood for the day, in a single tap
• Voice dictation for the evenings you'd rather not type
• "Thanks to what, or to whom?" — the why, if you feel like it
• A gentle daily reminder, at the time and on the days you choose
• Missed yesterday? You can still go back


🌸 YOUR PLANT, YOUR GARDEN

• Every gratitude you note opens a flower
• Your plant moves through five growth stages each month
• A small celebration when it joins your garden
• Your year at a glance: flowers opened, plants grown, days in bloom
• Give each of your plants a name


💐 THE DAYS WHEN IT ISN'T GOING WELL

This is where a positive journal actually earns its place.

• Support mode offers you a good memory when the day is rough
• The happiness bank: draw a random moment from everything you've kept
• Anniversaries: what you were living a week, a month, a year ago
• The Sunday bouquet: your week gathered into flowers


📅 WHAT YOU END UP LEARNING ABOUT YOURSELF

• Daily mood tracking: your whole month, day by day, in colour
• Your sources of happiness: twelve categories, from nature to the smallest treat
• The people who come up most often in your good things
• And sometimes the urge to thank them — Calluna helps you find the words


🤍 WHO IT'S FOR

• Anyone who wants a daily gratitude habit without spending their evenings on it
• Anyone who has opened a diary before and given up after a week
• Anyone who needs to see progress — that's what the plant is for
• Anyone looking for gentle mood tracking, with no scoring and no judgement
• Anyone building a self-care routine that survives a busy week
• Anyone who wants to look after their mental wellbeing two minutes at a time


🔒 YOUR WORDS STAY YOURS

It's a private journal. We built it like one.

• Your journal is stored on your phone. We don't read it: we don't have it.
• No account, no sign-up. No email, no password. You open it and you write.
• It works offline, on the train as easily as at the bottom of the garden.
• Back up to YOUR OWN Google Drive, or export to a file. Whenever you like.
• Fingerprint lock, if you prefer.
• No ads. No data resold. Your good things are of no interest to anyone but you.


🎁 FREE, GENUINELY

No subscription, no in-app purchases, no version that locks after seven days. The whole journal, all the time.

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.


Calluna is the Latin name for heather: the flower that opens at the end of the season, on the poorest soils, where almost nothing else grows.

There is always something worth picking.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

- Hormonal birth control and HRT impact on mood

- Sleep duration and quality

- Caffeine, alcohol, and substance use
- Exercise and movement minutes
- Daylight, weather, and seasonal changes
- Social interaction and isolation
- Work, school, and financial stress
- Diet, blood sugar, and skipped meals
- Custom triggers you discover over time

📈 INSIGHTS AND REPORTS
Months of entries turn into a clear picture:
- Mood stability across weeks and months
- Medication response and onset of effect
- Cycle correlations for PMDD and hormonal shifts
- Sleep, exercise, and mood overlay charts
- DBT diary card and CBT thought log views

- One-tap reports for psychiatry and therapy visits
- Highlight depressive episodes and crisis events
- Share read-only links with caregivers or partners
- Track therapy homework between sessions

📚 PATHWAYS AND EDUCATION
- CBT thought records for cognitive distortions
- DBT diary card prompts across distress tolerance, emotion regulation, interpersonal effectiveness, and mindfulness
- Behavioral activation for low-energy days
- Grounding exercises for ruminative loops and intrusive thoughts
- Plain-language guidance on mood disorders, bipolar, BPD, and PMDD

🛡️ PRIVACY AND SECURITY
- Optional passcode and biometric lock
- Offline-first, your journal stays on your device
- Encrypted cloud backup you control
- No ads, no selling your data, ever

If you are in crisis, please reach out to a local crisis line. In the US, dial 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.

Splitter is a simple bill splitter and expense tracker for friends, roommates, couples, and travel groups. Split bills, track shared expenses, see who owes what, and settle up — plus keep tabs on your own personal spending.

Whether it's a weekend trip, a shared apartment, or dinner with friends, someone always ends up fronting the bill. Splitter keeps the math straight so nobody has to remember who owes what, and settling up takes one tap instead of an awkward conversation.

SPLIT EXPENSES YOUR WAY
Split any bill equally, by percentage, or by exact amount per person. Add a category, a note, and a photo of the receipt — so there's never a dispute about what was actually spent.

SMART, SIMPLIFIED BALANCES
Instead of a dozen separate IOUs, Splitter works out the minimum number of payments needed to settle an entire group, updated the moment a new expense comes in.

SETTLE UP, WITH PROOF
Record a payment — cash, transfer, whatever — with an optional receipt photo. The person receiving it can confirm the settlement, and the full history stays on the group forever.

RECURRING EXPENSES
Rent, a shared subscription, the weekly grocery run — set the amount, frequency, and split once. Splitter regenerates it on schedule and automatically scales everyone's share if the amount changes.

PERSONAL EXPENSE TRACKING
Not everything is shared. Track your own day-to-day spending — separate from any group — with monthly summaries by currency, so your budget picture stays complete.

FRIENDS & GROUPS
Look a friend up by email and send a request. Once connected, add them to as many groups as you like — a trip, a household, a recurring hangout.

REAL-TIME NOTIFICATIONS
A new expense, a settlement to confirm, a friend request, a recurring bill coming due — you'll know the moment it happens.

MULTI-CURRENCY
Every group has its own currency, so a trip abroad and your rent back home never get mixed up in the same balance.

SPENDING INSIGHTS
A visual breakdown of where your money actually goes, by category, across both group and personal expenses.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your personal expenses are visible only to you — never to friends or group members. Inside a group, members only ever see what's actually shared there. We don't sell your data, and Splitter has no ads.

PERFECT FOR
• Roommates splitting rent, utilities, and groceries
• Trips and travel with friends
• Couples sharing household costs
• Dinners, parties, and group events
• Anyone who wants a simple personal budget tracker

Sign in with Google or email in seconds and set up your first group in under a minute.

Splitter — split bills, not friendships.

Imagine a situation, you go to the same place for lunch every day and order about the same meals.

After lunch you pay at the restaurant.

When visiting a restaurant, add the dishes you ordered to the calculator from the 👉Food screen. You can do this by clicking the add button near the name.

Next, go to the 👉Calculator tab and select them using the checkbox to the right of each dish or by pressing.

The app will calculate the total cost of your lunch.

Before going to the restaurant

You should start working with the application from the restaurants tab.
Add all the places where you go to eat on this tab.

Next, go to the 👉 Food tab and select add from the menu.

Add all the dishes you would normally order for each of your restaurants. Specify the price of each dish and select a restaurant when adding.

It is better to take a picture of the restaurant menu before going to it and add the main dishes that you plan or already order often.


How to use app in a restaurant?
After lunch, add all the dishes you ordered through the 👉 Food tab. Click add next to each dish.

You can change a restaurant in the drop-down list of dishes at the top of the list of dishes. All dishes of the selected restaurant will be shown.

Another alternative option for filling out the list for calculating the cost is to go to the Restaurants tab and by long-clicking on the selected restaurant select 👉Load menu.

Next, go to the 👉Calculator tab and mark the dishes you want.
The price of all dishes will be calculated at the top next to the For pay label.

If suddenly you need to find out the price for half a portion, then by long pressing in the calculator menu, select 👉Half portion. The price of the selected dish will be halved.

If you ordered a new dish that is not in your calculation list, select Add dish from the menu and set the dish name and price.

The dish will be included in the calculation immediately
How to delete dishes from calculation
With a long press on each dish, a menu appears. Select 👉Delete from the menu and the selected dish will be removed from the list. To delete all dishes from the calculator - select 👉Clear

Deleting a dish in the calculator does not delete it from the application. It remains in the list of all dishes.

Finally, delete the dish through the menu by long pressing on the dish on the 👉Food tab.

name: Foil: Pill Reminder & Tracker
description:
Foil is a pill reminder that keeps asking until you mark the dose. If you haven't tapped Taken, it reminds you again after 10, 30 and 60 minutes and stops the moment you do. Reminders are free for every medication you add, with no account and no ads.

Reminders that keep asking
- Follow-ups at 10, 30 and 60 minutes by default. Pick other gaps or turn them off.
- Each follow-up replaces the last one, so reminders never pile up.
- Mark Taken, Snooze or Skip right from the notification.
- Send a test reminder while you set up and watch it arrive before you rely on it.
- Quiet hours for follow-ups at night. The first reminder always arrives.
- The Reliability check shows what can silence a medication reminder on your phone, like notification permission, exact alarms and battery optimization, and opens the right setting to fix it.

Every schedule a prescription can have
- Once or several times a day, with a different amount at each time
- Specific weekdays, every few days, or every few hours
- On and off cycles, with start and end dates
- As needed, with the limits you enter, such as at most 3 a day, 4 hours apart
- Birth control packs: 21 + 7, 24 + 4, 28 continuous, 84 + 7 or your own count, drawn like the real pack with today's pill ringed
- Weekly injections, with an optional reminder the evening before and injection site rotation that remembers where you injected last

Your medications, clearly labeled
Add a medication and Foil sets its label as you type: name, strength, how much and when, plus instructions such as "with food". Today shows what is due now and what comes next. Tap a dose to mark it, or record that you took it earlier. Editing a schedule never rewrites the days behind you. It works as a simple med tracker and medication log as much as a reminder.

A record your doctor can read
- A month calendar of every dose: taken on time, late, skipped with your reason, or missed
- Patterns in plain words, like the time of day that slips most (Pro)
- A doctor report as a PDF with each medication's schedule and how often it was taken (Pro)
- Refills and supply: how much is left, a reminder before you run out, and refills left on the prescription (Pro)

Private by design
- No account, no sign-up. Your medications and dose history stay on your phone.
- Discreet mode: notifications show "Foil" and the time instead of medication names. On your home screen the app is simply called Foil.
- App lock with your fingerprint, face or screen lock (Pro)
- Backup and export to JSON or CSV, free

What's free and what Pro adds
Free for good: unlimited medications and reminders, follow-ups until marked, every schedule type and birth control packs, Taken from the notification, 30 days of history (older days are kept), discreet mode, backup and export. Nothing you set up for free becomes paid later.

Foil Pro adds the full history with insights, the doctor report, refills and supply, your own follow-up timing, App lock, and an alarm for medications you mark as critical: if the dose is still not marked, the last reminder rings as an alarm, even when your phone is on vibrate, and it stops as soon as you mark the dose.

Foil Pro comes as a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. You can cancel the subscription anytime in your Google Play account.

Foil reminds you of the schedule your doctor or pharmacist gave you and keeps a record of it. It does not give medical advice and does not calculate doses. Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before changing how you take a medication.

Foil is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. There are many things which you may want to improve. HabitBull can be used as a planner in building habits like taking your pills regularly, exercise, or keep to a diet.
