name: Warranty Drawer: Tracker
description:
The kitchen drawer full of receipts and warranty cards, made searchable — and it reminds you before a warranty runs out.

WARRANTY TRACKER: A PHOTO IS THE WHOLE JOB
Snap the receipt, the warranty card or the product label. Warranty Drawer reads the merchant, product, purchase date, price and warranty term, works out the expiry date, files the item under a category and sets the reminders. Every field is editable, a scan never blocks filing, and the text it read from is shown right beside each field so a wrong read is caught in one glance.

READ ON YOUR PHONE, NOT UPLOADED
Receipts are read on the device. When you're online, only the extracted text is sent to our service to tidy the title and pick a category — the photo itself never leaves your phone unless you explicitly tap to send one. Nothing about a receipt is stored on our servers.

WARRANTY REMINDERS THAT FIRE
30, 7 and 1 days before a warranty or return window ends, a local notification lands on this phone. No account, no server, nothing to break.

RECALL ALERTS FOR THE THINGS YOU FILED
A warranty tracker with recall alerts: on app open the public US recall list (CPSC; NHTSA for vehicles) is downloaded to your phone and compared with your items there. A match shows on the cabinet and the item with the reason. Your items never leave the phone; turn it off in Settings.

WARRANTY ORGANIZER YOU CAN SEARCH
Find "the fridge receipt" six months later by merchant, product, category, amount ("300+") or "expiring". Sort by expiry, purchase date, price or merchant. Ten ready-made categories, from appliances to tools.

MANUFACTURER DEFAULTS
When the paper says nothing, the brand's published standard term applies where we have it sourced, else 12 months for electronics and appliances, 36 for tools, the 2-year statutory minimum in the EU and UK — always labelled as a default you can change.

YOUR DRAWER STAYS YOURS
Local-first. The drawer lives on your phone and is never held behind a login. Export the whole drawer — items, dates and every photo — as a ZIP at any time, signed in or not. Restore shows what it replaces first and can be undone.

OPTIONAL BACKUP & SYNC
Sign in with Google or Apple, or back up as a guest with a recovery code you keep. Either way the cloud copy restores on a new phone and lets your household share one drawer. Sign-in is offered, never required. No passwords, no codes by text.

WARRANTY DRAWER+
Unlimited items · receipt, warranty card and serial plate together on one item · return windows and extended plans, each with its own reminders · the claim helper, which builds a dated evidence PDF with a claim letter before you talk to anyone · home inventory exports of the whole drawer as CSV and PDF, ready for insurance or a move.

The free tier files ten items with the full snap-to-file flow, reminders and backup — backup and reminders are never paid features.

Warranty Drawer+ is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription (the yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Google Play account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before the end of the current period; manage or cancel in Google Play > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://adelyons.com/apps/warrantydrawer/eula.html
Privacy Policy: https://adelyons.com/apps/warrantydrawer/privacy.html

WHAT PEOPLE SEARCH FOR, AND WHAT THIS IS
A warranty tracker app and warranty reminder app in one: a receipt warranty organizer that keeps your proof of purchase and tells you before the cover ends. A warranty scanner app — photograph the receipt, card or label and it files itself. A warranty manager app for appliances, electronics and tools, with return-window and extended-warranty clocks, a warranty claim helper, and a product recall alert when something you filed is recalled. Product warranty tracker, warranty organizer app, warranty expiry reminder, home inventory app for insurance. One drawer, on your phone, no account.

📊 Track Every Layer of Coverage
Most receipt managers only track a single expiry date. WarrantyWiz tracks the full picture so nothing slips through:
- Primary warranty from the manufacturer
- Extended warranties purchased separately
- Store guarantees from the retailer
- Sub-component coverage for parts like compressors, batteries, or panels, which often outlast the product's main warranty

A clear coverage timeline shows exactly what is protected and when each layer expires. When the main warranty ends but a store guarantee or component warranty is still running, the item appears under Partially Expired, so you know you can still claim.

📋 What You Can Track
- Electronics: Phones, laptops, TVs, cameras, and gaming consoles
- Home Appliances: Washing machines, AC units, refrigerators
- Personal Items: Watches, furniture, tools, and high-value purchases

✅ Key Features
1. Store receipts and product images as photos or PDFs, with no more fading thermal paper.
2. Set custom expiry alerts so you never miss a claim window.
3. Use the dashboard to see Total, Expiring Soon, Partially Expired and Expired items at a glance.
4. Scan serial numbers and barcodes instead of typing them, and search your inventory by serial.
5. Organize with default or custom categories, each with its own icon.
6. Log brand names, sellers, and detailed multi-line notes for repair histories.
7. Archive items you no longer need to track without losing the historical record.
8. Share item details in one tap, perfect for filing a claim or visiting a repair shop.
9. Export and download receipts and product images anytime.
10. Secure your vault with a Biometric lock (fingerprint / face unlock).
11. Backup and restore locally to ensure your data stays in your control.

💎 Free & Pro
WarrantyWiz is free to use, with generous limits on items, custom categories, exports, PDF views and AutoFill. WarrantyWiz Pro removes those limits. Pro is free for everyone until 15 Nov 2026, and early users keep it free until 15 Nov 2027. The items you save stay with you afterwards. Reminders, warranty tracking and local backup always stay free.

💡 Why It Matters
Out-of-warranty repairs are expensive. A simple part replacement can turn into a massive bill without proper coverage. WarrantyWiz keeps your purchase records organized so you can claim the repairs you are entitled to.

No cloud. No tracking. No nonsense.
Download WarrantyWiz and build your secure offline home inventory in under two minutes.

description:
HVAC Field Toolkit is an offline field suite for residential and light-commercial HVAC techs in North America and Europe — charging math, PT lookup, psychrometrics, and EPA Section 608 study in one app, even without cell signal.

Not just another superheat calculator: work rooftops and mechanical rooms with a toolkit built for EPA-minded techs who need results they can share.

FREE TOOLS
• Superheat and subcooling with °F/°C and psi/bar/kPa switching — TXV vs fixed-orifice paths
• PT charts for common refrigerants — R-410A, R-32, R-454B, R-22, R-134a, R-448A, R-507A, R-717, R-290, and more
• Zeotropic blends: bubble (liquid) and dew (vapor) so SH uses dew and SC uses bubble
• Psychrometric calculator: dry bulb, wet bulb, dew point, RH, enthalpy, humidity ratio
• Delta T, temperature/pressure converters, voltage drop
• Refrigerant reference cards, favorites, and recent tools
• One free PDF export preview to try job-site sharing

PRO — ONE-TIME UNLOCK ($9.99)
• EPA Section 608 study: Core / Type I / II / III practice and timed exams
• Target superheat for fixed-orifice charging (generic field chart — prefer OEM when available)
• Named Jobs: save and reopen field calculations
• Unlimited PDF reports to share with customers or the shop
• Duct sizing (equal friction / Manual D–style helpers)
• Airflow and run-capacitor checkers
• Remove banner ads

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Light and dark themes, readable industrial UI
• Local history and favorites on device — no account for core tools
• 18 languages for crews that work across regions

IMPORTANT
Target superheat values are a generic approximation for fixed-orifice systems. Manufacturer charging charts (Carrier, Trane, Goodman, Lennox, and others) can differ. TXV and EEV systems should be charged by subcooling per OEM instructions. PT data is field-grade for service work, not a laboratory REFPROP substitute.

Download HVAC Field Toolkit — EPA study, offline PT/SH/SC, Jobs, and PDF reports in one $9.99 unlock.

name: Hvacio: Serwis HVAC, Przeglądy
description:
Hvacio to mobilna aplikacja dla niezależnych serwisantów branży HVAC w Polsce. Pozwala prowadzić bazę klientów, rejestr urządzeń i historię wizyt serwisowych bezpośrednio z telefonu, także bez dostępu do internetu w terenie. Po zakończonej wizycie automatycznie generujesz protokół serwisowy w formacie PDF i wysyłasz go do klienta jednym kliknięciem.

Aplikacja jest narzędziem profesjonalnym, zaprojektowanym dla osób obsługujących kotły gazowe i urządzenia objęte dozorem UDT, klimatyzacje typu split, multisplit i VRF, pompy ciepła powietrze-woda oraz gruntowe, rekuperatory i wentylację mechaniczną. Sprawdzi się też w serwisie innych urządzeń HVAC, ponieważ formularz wizyty pozwala dostosować listę czynności do typu obsługiwanego sprzętu.

W aplikacji prowadzisz bazę klientów wraz z pełnymi danymi kontaktowymi, adresem i numerami identyfikacyjnymi firmy. Dla klientów biznesowych dane firmy można pobrać automatycznie z rejestru REGON Głównego Urzędu Statystycznego po podaniu NIP, bez ręcznego przepisywania. Bazę można też zaimportować z pliku Excel, jeśli prowadziłeś ją wcześniej w arkuszu.

Do każdego klienta przypisujesz urządzenia, które serwisujesz, wraz z numerami seryjnymi i historią przeglądów. Podczas wizyty wybierasz urządzenie, zaznaczasz wykonane czynności z listy dopasowanej do jego typu i opisujesz zużyte materiały. Wszystko zapisuje się od razu w pamięci telefonu, a po powrocie w zasięg sieci synchronizuje się z chmurą.

Każdej wizycie możesz dorzucić zdjęcia urządzenia robione prosto z aplikacji oraz notatki głosowe nagrywane w terenie. Notatki głosowe pozwalają udokumentować szczegóły obsługi szybciej, niż pisanie palcem na ekranie podczas pracy w kotłowni czy na dachu.

Po zakończeniu wizyty aplikacja generuje protokół serwisowy w PDF, zawierający dane firmy, listę wykonanych czynności, użyte materiały i datę przeglądu. Protokół wysyłasz klientowi e-mailem prosto z aplikacji. W stopce możesz dorzucić link do formularza opinii Google Maps, który pomaga budować pozytywne oceny firmy w wyszukiwarce.

Każdy serwisant otrzymuje publiczną mini-stronę pod adresem hvacio.pl, na której prezentowane są dane kontaktowe i lista obsługiwanych typów urządzeń. Strona ma uporządkowane meta-dane dla wyszukiwarek, dzięki czemu klienci szukający lokalnego serwisu mogą cię znaleźć w Google.

Powiadomienia push przypominają o nadchodzących przeglądach, dzięki czemu nie tracisz zlecenia z powodu zapomnianej daty.

Wszystkie dane synchronizują się przez bezpieczne połączenie HTTPS. Zdjęcia i nagrania głosowe trzymamy w europejskim regionie chmury, we Frankfurcie. Subskrypcję obsługujemy na stronie hvacio.pl, w aplikacji nie ma żadnych płatności wewnętrznych.

Procedura usunięcia konta i wszystkich powiązanych danych dostępna jest pod adresem hvacio.pl/usun-konto. Pomoc techniczna oraz pytania o prywatność: support@hvacio.pl.

name: ADHD Organizer: Llama Life
description:
Llama Life is a daily task planner and organizer, designed to help you focus on ONE task at a time - so you're not just making lists, you're actually getting THROUGH them!

Llama Life let’s you set a countdown timer for *every* task. This concept is called ‘timeboxing’, and the idea is to create a (positive) constraint around the time we have to do something. The goal is to try and give a task 100% of our attention, until the timer runs out. This helps to increase focus, and gives us the mental space to think about ONE thing at a time.

Llama Life also let’s you know your total List Time, and the estimated finishing time, so you can be more aware of time passing, and plan your day.

We also love celebrating the wins, big or small, so very importantly, you get confetti (woo hoo!) when you finish a task. You can also personalize with color and emoji to get lots of variety and keep things fun and fresh!

Llama Life offers a 7-day free trial, with a Monthly or Annual subscription.

All the best,
Marie

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:

Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

You understand the long-term value of these tasks, but how much does this half-hour of focus matter right now?

● Repetition Leads to Boredom:
When the initial novelty wears off, the repetitive nature of the task can make you feel bored and tired.

● Overly Negative Focus:
Focusing on what you haven't accomplished rather than acknowledging what you have done can lead to negative self-evaluation and loss of motivation.

Let Exocus Help You!


====== Exocus Solutions ======

Exocus is a gamified focus timer that visualizes your concentration as a planet's evolution, helping you achieve long-term, pain-free focus.

● Emotional Design and Sense of Meaning
After each focus session, you’ll see the story of what happened to your planet during that time. Even five minutes of focus equals 38.53 million years of evolution for your planet, so your focus is crucial. Want to raise the stakes? ● Stage-Based Incentives
Short-term Incentives: After each focus session, the planet’s landscape changes and tells you its story.

Long-term Incentives: After around ten hours of focus, the planet completes its evolution. You can then add it to your star system, with each project corresponding to a star system, showcasing your long-term accumulation in that project.

● Continuous Freshness
We offer hundreds of unique planet designs, satisfying your curiosity and desire to collect with constant surprises. See a planet's full appearance only after evolving it through focused efforts. Earn Stardust coins by focusing to unlock new planet seeds, motivating continuous concentration.

Exocus uses a unique pixel art style, maintaining simplicity while incorporating delightful little Easter eggs for you to discover. We believe the beauty of Exocus can bring joy, which will ultimately translate into more focused time.

Exocus embraces gamified design in a bold yet restrained and professional manner. We hope the game elements help you enjoy focusing, and we also care deeply about your ability to truly focus. Each project corresponds to a planet. You can track different categories of focus time with projects and quickly switch between projects on the home screen by swiping left or right.

Based on your focus data, we provide personalized charts to help you understand your focus patterns and stay motivated to maintain consistent focus.

name: Soothfy: ADHD Planner, Anxiety
description:
Soothfy is an ADHD planner and mental health app built for people whose brains work differently. If anxiety, OCD, PTSD, or panic attacks make daily life harder than it needs to be, you are in the right place.

Most mental health apps were not built for how ADHD and anxious brains actually work. They give you a generic meditation when you are mid panic attack, or a to-do list when executive function has completely shut down. Soothfy was built around the reality of living with these conditions, not the ideal version of it.

The feature our users come back to every day is Instant Relief. When anxiety spikes, when ADHD makes focusing impossible, or when a panic attack starts, you open Soothfy and work through four steps. Pick your condition, choose the exact symptom from thirty five options, describe what is happening right now, and get 
three CBT activities built for that exact situation with a two minute timer. Not something generic. Something designed for the moment you are in. You track whether it worked, so over time Soothfy learns what actually helps you and what to skip.

Your daily ADHD planner rebuilds every cycle. The AI takes your condition, mood, energy level, and time of day into account before generating a fresh twenty day plan. Every plan includes CBT exercises, focus timers, executive function tasks, habit stacking, behavioral activation, and journaling sessions. Nothing repeats, 
and because the planner understands that ADHD brains do not perform consistently, it adjusts rather than punishing you for the hard days.

The CBT education library walks you through the ABC model, assertiveness training, behavioral activation, and behavior tracking in a way that is practical and specific to your condition. The same tools therapists spend sessions teaching, built into your daily routine so you are applying them in real life, not just reading about them.

The mood tracker and anxiety tracker turn daily check-ins into something genuinely useful. Log your emotions, anxiety levels, and sleep quality every day and Soothfy builds weekly and monthly trend charts that show your actual patterns, your triggers, and how sleep connects to focus, anxiety, and everything else. You can download your mood and anxiety reports and bring them to a therapist or doctor who can actually use that data to help you.

The anxiety journal lets you write, record voice notes, and attach therapeutic sounds directly to entries. The sleep tracker shows how rest affects your ADHD focus and anxiety over time. For neurodivergent users and anyone managing insomnia, stress, or emotional dysregulation, having somewhere to put the weight of the day before sleep is not a small thing. The sound therapy library gives you curated audio designed for ADHD and anxiety, not generic noise. The ADHD timer keeps you on task when executive function is struggling.

Anchor Habits connect your mental health activities to routines you already have. Instead of building new habits from nothing, Soothfy helps you stack CBT exercises onto things you already do every day. That is why the habits built inside this app actually last.

The community brings together people managing ADHD, anxiety, OCD, PTSD, depression, and emotional dysregulation. Real people sharing what is working, what is not, and what living with these conditions honestly looks like day to day. It is moderated, it is honest, and it is the kind of support that reminds you that you are not dealing with this alone.

Soothfy covers nine conditions in one app. ADHD, anxiety, depression, OCD, PTSD, stress, insomnia, anger, and emotional dysregulation. One subscription covers everything. You do not need a different app for each condition you are managing.
The app is free to download. Your first relief session takes under two minutes.

Whether you are newly diagnosed, exploring an ADHD test, supporting a child with ADHD, or managing ADHD as an adult through medication and CBT, this ADHD app turns daily focus, energy, mood, sleep, and side effects into clear data you and your psychiatrist or therapist can actually use.

🎯 WHAT THIS ADHD TRACKER DOES

🔥 Symptom and Focus Tracking
Log ADHD symptoms the way they actually show up: distractibility, hyperfocus, time blindness, task initiation, working memory lapses, impulsivity, restlessness, emotional dysregulation, rejection sensitive dysphoria (RSD), and overwhelm. Rate focus on a 1 to 10 scale, mark which tasks you finished, and tag what derailed you.

💊 Medication Management
Track the full ADHD regimen in one place: stimulants like methylphenidate (Ritalin, Concerta, Focalin), amphetamines (Adderall, Vyvanse), non stimulants (Strattera, Intuniv, Qelbree), modafinil, and supplements. Log dose, time, food, side effects (appetite loss, sleep changes, anxiety, rebound), and effectiveness window.

🧠 Routine and Habit Builder
Build ADHD friendly routines that actually stick. Morning, work, study, evening, and bedtime sequences with body doubling timers. Track which routine steps you do versus drop, so you can see what your brain actually keeps and what falls off.

🔍 Triggers and Patterns
Log sleep, hormonal cycle, caffeine, sugar, screen time, exercise, and stress to find what tanks your focus and what restores it. Connect bad ADHD days to sleep loss, hyperfocus crashes, or unmedicated weekends.

⏰ Medication Reminders and Adherence
Never miss a stimulant dose. Schedule with food prompts, water reminders, and rebound warnings. Streaks and refill alerts keep your ADHD treatment on track and help with controlled substance refill timing.

📊 Doctor Ready ADHD Reports
Generate clean PDF ADHD reports covering daily focus scores, medication response curves, side effect patterns, sleep changes, and routine adherence. Share with your psychiatrist, ADHD coach, or pediatrician before every appointment to fine tune doses.

💪 Mood, Sleep, and Health Connect
Track mood, anxiety, irritability, and sleep alongside ADHD. Sync steps, heart rate, and sleep stages from Health Connect or wearables so you can see how exercise and rest move your focus.

Your health data belongs to you. We never sell or share personal information. Optional cloud backup uses end to end encryption. Local first storage keeps your ADHD data on your device by default.

name: Battery Watch: Battery Monitor
description:
Battery Watch is a battery monitoring app for Android. View battery level, temperature, current and voltage, explore recorded charging and discharging sessions, and follow screen-on and screen-off usage over time. Use recorded data to understand battery habits.

LIVE BATTERY READINGS
See the readings your phone makes available, including battery percentage, temperature in degrees Celsius, current in mA and voltage in V. Power in W is calculated from the reported battery current and voltage. It describes power at the battery, rather than a direct measurement of your charger's output. Open a metric to view its recorded trend.

CHARGING AND DISCHARGING HISTORY
Review saved sessions with their duration, starting and ending battery levels, and available average current, voltage and temperature readings. Browse charging and discharging separately. Session charts show changes during a charge or a period of battery use. Records begin when tracking runs; the app cannot recover battery samples it never recorded.

SCREEN AND SLEEP INSIGHTS
Explore recorded screen-on time, screen-off time, deep-sleep duration and Android Doze intervals. Where charge-counter readings are available, see estimated battery drain during recorded screen-on and screen-off periods. These summaries describe observed device activity; they do not identify every cause of battery drain.

Optional Usage Access adds historical screen events and foreground app-usage information. Per-app drain figures, when shown, allocate observed drain using foreground activity time. They are estimates, not direct measurements of each app's energy consumption. Missing events or monitoring gaps can leave parts of a period unaccounted for.

BATTERY AND TEMPERATURE REMINDERS
Turn battery-level and temperature reminders on or off, and receive a notification when a configured threshold is reached. Notifications must be allowed in Android settings. Reminders depend on fresh battery readings and may be delayed by background restrictions. Turning reminder switches on or off is free. Editing charge and temperature limits requires Pro or an eligible rewarded-ad unlock. A charge-level reminder does not stop charging.

CAPACITY, HEALTH AND CYCLES
View estimated remaining charge and design-capacity values where available. Battery health is an estimate derived from reported charge, battery percentage and design capacity, using qualifying charging observations when available. An initial reading may only support a preliminary approximation. These figures do not establish the battery's exact physical condition or remaining lifespan.

A device-reported cycle count is shown when Android or the device exposes an accessible counter. Otherwise, Battery Watch can estimate equivalent full discharge cycles from the battery use observed since tracking began. This estimate is not a recovered lifetime cycle count. Older Android versions and some newer devices may not supply a hardware count.

WIDGETS AND MONITORING OPTIONS
Add a battery-temperature widget for a quick view from your home screen. Choose light or dark appearance in the app and select a tracking level in Settings. Persistent monitoring uses an ongoing notification to help record activity while the app is in the background. Lighter tracking modes use fewer background mechanisms. Android and manufacturer restrictions can still interrupt collection, so history may contain gaps.

AVAILABILITY AND OPTIONAL UPGRADES
Battery Watch supports Android 9 and newer. Individual readings depend on the sensors, Android version and information exposed by your device. Battery conditions and reported values can change with charge level, temperature and phone activity; review several sessions for context.

The app is free to download and includes ads and in-app purchases. Pro unlocks additional features, including advanced statistics and eligible widget options. Some features offer temporary access through rewarded ads. See options and pricing in the app before purchase.

name: Spider Tracker
description:
Somewhere out there, something keeps turning up on rooftops. Nobody agrees on what it is. Spider Tracker is where you write it down.

This is a sighting tracker built around a world map. You log what you saw and where, mark it confirmed or rumored, and watch the grid fill in over time. Everything stays on your phone.

THE GRID
Your sightings sit on a pixel world map you can pan, zoom and filter. Confirmed reports show green, rumors show red, events show blue, so you can read the state of the world at a glance. Tap any marker to open the full report. Filter down to one class when the grid gets busy.

REPORT WHAT YOU SAW
Drop a pin anywhere on the map, name the place, pick a classification, and write down what happened. Set the time yourself if you are logging it late. Change your mind afterwards and a rumor can be promoted to confirmed, or the other way around.

ACTIVITY LOG
Every report you file lands in the log, newest first, grouped by day. Today, yesterday, earlier this week. Filter by classification, open any entry to edit or delete it.

INTEL
The log adds up to something. Intel shows your totals, how much of your grid is confirmed rather than rumor, which region runs hottest, when you last logged anything, and the hour of day sightings actually spike. All of it is worked out from your own reports.

DAILY SWEEP
One sweep a day turns up a fresh unverified report from somewhere in the world. It lands on the grid as a rumor, and it is your call whether to confirm it or clear it. The sweep resets at midnight.

TRIANGULATE
There is a game inside the tracker. A report comes in naming a city, and you pin where you think it is. Five reports to a run. The closer your pin, the more it scores, and the map zooms in afterwards to show you exactly how far off you were. Good for learning the map, and hard to put down once you start chasing a better run.

BADGES AND STREAKS
Ten badges to unlock, from your first report through fifty of them, five regions covered, a sighting logged after midnight, and a week long streak. Your streak holds for as long as you keep logging.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
No account. No sign up. The app requests no permissions at all and contains no network code, so nothing leaves your phone because there is nowhere for it to go. It works in airplane mode, underground, or with the SIM out.

Spider Tracker is a work of fiction. The sightings are yours to invent, and the fun is in building a case file nobody else has. Not affiliated with any film, studio, or character.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

name: NTsocial
description:
NTsocial is a peer-to-peer communication app that does not depend on a central server. When internet access or cellular service is unavailable, supported devices can still exchange messages over a BLE mesh. Wi-Fi and LoRa add higher-speed and longer-range paths when compatible hardware is available.

BLE, Wi-Fi, and LoRa

• BLE is the baseline path for nearby discovery, message relaying, history sync, images, voice messages, and push-to-talk.
• BLE Long Range Mode is available on compatible devices with LE Coded PHY.
• High-speed Wi-Fi can sync history and transfer large files in private chats. NTsocial prefers Wi-Fi Aware, with native Android Wi-Fi Direct as a fallback. A compatible Windows Direct path is also available for manually end-to-end encrypted file sessions. No internet connection or cloud server is required.
• File transfers support accept or decline, resume, progress display, and SHA-256 integrity verification. File data is never sent over LoRa.
• Install the separate, free, open-source NTsocial MeshLink app and connect compatible Meshtastic hardware to carry mapped channel text and sync data over LoRa. BLE remains active for nearby communication and media.

Up to four Meshtastic hardware nodes

With NTsocial MeshLink, one phone can register up to four Meshtastic hardware nodes. Each NTsocial channel can bind one Meshtastic channel from each node, allowing the same NTsocial channel to map to as many as four hardware nodes at once. MeshLink manages the radio connections, while NTsocial manages the conversation interface and message history. LoRa features require the separate MeshLink app and Meshtastic hardware.

Optional manual end-to-end encryption

Users can enable a higher-assurance end-to-end mode for private messages. After both people enter the same shared secret on their own devices, NTsocial derives a 256-bit private-message key. The shared secret is not exchanged over BLE. This mode can protect private text, images, voice messages, and private files. It is manually enabled; not every private-message state should be treated as having the same level of end-to-end protection.

Communication and collaboration

• Public posts, channels, and one-to-one private messages
• Reply threads, images, voice messages, and half-duplex push-to-talk
• Channel creation, membership, and sharing by QR code, image, or link
• Offline maps, GPX, DEM, map objects, and ATaK channel collaboration
• Profiles, avatars, favorites, blocking, and MESH Pet

Roadmap

MeshCore is not included in this release. The next planned step is MeshCore compatibility, moving toward a decentralized communication platform that brings together BLE, Wi-Fi, and LoRa through Meshtastic and MeshCore.

Feature availability depends on the device, Android version, permissions, and nearby peers.

name: Gluten Dude: GF Restaurants
description:

If you have celiac disease or a gluten intolerance, you've probably done this before.

You find a restaurant that looks promising.

You read reviews. You search Facebook groups. You look at crowdsourced apps. You study the menu. You call the restaurant. You hope the person on the phone actually understands what you're asking.

Then our team gets to work.

First, we research the restaurant — looking into their gluten-free practices and reputation before we ever reach out.

Then we vet it directly. We contact the restaurant and ask the questions that matter. How do they prevent cross-contact? Is there a dedicated fryer? Does the staff understand celiac disease?

Then we write everything up in plain English, so you know what to expect before you ever walk through the door.

Community starting points.

Independent research.

Complete transparency.

WHY I BUILT GLUTEN DUDE.

I've had celiac disease since 2007.

Like you, I've spent way too much time trying to figure out where it was actually safe to eat. I've been glutened by restaurants that sounded confident. I've asked all the awkward questions.

After years of doing the same research over and over, I had one thought:

Why isn't someone doing this for us?

So I built the app I wished I'd had.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING AT.

Every restaurant is clearly labeled, so there's never any guessing about what you're getting.

• 100% Gluten-Free
Dedicated gluten-free restaurants.

• Dude Vetted
Personally researched by our team, complete with detailed notes about cross-contact procedures, kitchen practices, dedicated fryers, and staff knowledge.

• User Suggested
Restaurants we've researched but couldn't fully verify directly, backed by positive experiences from our community.

• Trusted Chains
Chain restaurants our community consistently trusts.

No mystery ratings.

No hidden scoring.

Just complete transparency.

BUILT FOR LIFE WITH CELIAC.

Gluten Dude is more than a gluten-free restaurant finder.

It's a travel companion.

• Trip Planner
Find trusted restaurants along your exact driving route.

• Airport Dining
Browse gluten-free options in more than 100 airports, organized by terminal.

• Destination Planning
Know your safest dining options before you leave home.

Because the best trips are the ones where you spend your time making memories, not searching for your next meal.

NO PAY-TO-PLAY.

Restaurants can't pay to be featured. No ads influencing what you see.

Every restaurant is here because it earned its place.

Because trust is everything.

SAVE MONEY.

Living gluten-free is expensive enough.

Gluten Dude members get exclusive discounts on hundreds of gluten-free products to help make it a little easier.

TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS.

"Your approach is far superior to other apps in terms of safety. Your app is desperately needed." - Sandy

"Nothing else I've seen has the breadth of up-to-date, peace-of-mind info on where to safely go." - GF Seeker

"I feel much more confident using your app vs. any other. How diligent you are is what separates you from the rest." - Laura

"I won't use any other app besides yours - because safety first!" - Kelly

"Love the app when I was planning a road trip! So nice being able to see different routes with GF options!" - Kristen

FROM SOMEONE WHO GETS IT...

I know what it's like to stand outside a restaurant wondering if you're making the right decision.

I know what it's like to be tired of second-guessing every meal.

That's why Gluten Dude exists.

Not to tell you where to eat.

To help you feel confident about where you choose to eat.

name: Gluten Free Scanner
description:
Gluten Free Scanner is a food barcode scanner that tells you in seconds whether a food is gluten free. When it isn't, the result tells you why.

Built for people with coeliac disease (celiac disease in the US) and gluten intolerance, whether you're shopping for yourself or for someone else.

- Instant: point the barcode scanner at any product and get your answer before you put the box down
- Millions of products: more added every day
- Free to download and scan: no account, no sign-up, unlimited scans
- Six languages: English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Spanish
- Works offline: our verdict database, downloaded to your phone
- Scan history: every result you scan, saved for next time

It names the ingredient
A red light is only half an answer. When a product contains gluten, this ingredient checker names the one responsible, wherever the database has that detail, so you start spotting the usual suspects on labels yourself.

Just diagnosed?
The first weeks of a gluten free diet are a crash course. What has gluten in it? Is soy sauce gluten free? Which beer can you still drink? The app answers those questions while you find your feet, so the grocery shop stops feeling like an exam.

Missing product? Get an answer anyway
Sooner or later you'll scan something the app hasn't seen before. Photograph the barcode, the name, and the ingredients list, and often you'll have a verdict while you're still in the aisle. If it needs a human eye, we review it, and your addition is there for the next person who picks up that product.

Offline mode (Premium)
Supermarket dead spots, basement aisles, flights. Download the database once over Wi-Fi and the food scanner carries on with no signal at all; it refreshes itself the next time you open the app online. It packs well, too: scan your way round a supermarket abroad with mobile data switched off.

Scan history (Premium)
Every result is saved, so you look a product up once and the answer is waiting next week. No more trying to remember which brand it was that passed.

Share what you find
Scanning for a child, a partner, or a friend? Share a product's result in one tap, so everyone doing the shopping sees the same answer.

For every gluten free shopper
Coeliac disease, non-coeliac gluten sensitivity, a gluten intolerance, or a coeliac friend coming to dinner: the question in the aisle is the same. Is it gluten free? Scan snacks, cereals, bread, pasta, sauces, chocolate, and drinks on the weekly grocery shop, and get a straight answer on each one.

A note on gluten
Gluten comes from wheat, barley, rye, spelt, and triticale. On a label it hides behind names like barley malt, malt extract, wheat starch, and hydrolysed wheat protein, and it turns up where you least expect it: soy sauce, stock cubes, soups, sweets, and beer. The app reads the ingredients and warnings recorded for a product and flags the ones that mean gluten, including "may contain" and shared-facility warnings where they're recorded, so you're not decoding every label on your own. It can only read what's on record for a product, so always check the packaging, and talk to your doctor about managing coeliac or celiac disease. Gluten Free Scanner is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.

Install it before your next shop and try it on whatever's in the cupboard.

name: SafeMeal: Food Allergy Card
description:
SafeMeal is the food allergy card for eating out, at home and when you travel. It turns your allergies, celiac disease, intolerances or diet into a clear chef card in the local language, with English under each food so you always know what it says. Show it to the waiter or the chef, down the street or on the other side of the world. No phrasebook, no guessing, no signal needed.

Like a printed allergy translation card, but in 143 languages, always up to date, easy to share, and with the local dishes to watch out for.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick what you can't eat: 220+ foods and 30+ ready-made lists, from peanut and tree nut allergy to gluten-free, lactose intolerance, halal, kosher and vegan.
• Say how serious it is: severe allergy (red), strict avoidance (orange) or preference (yellow). The card's color and wording tell the kitchen how careful to be.
• Travel: going to Japan, Thailand, Italy or Mexico? SafeMeal finds the country you're in and shows your card in its language. Change it anytime, for any of more than 230 countries and territories.
• Show your allergy card at the restaurant.

MORE THAN A TRANSLATION CARD
• Often hidden in: tap a food to see the local dishes that commonly contain it where you are. Peanuts in the curry, anchovy in the salad dressing, wheat in the soy sauce: SafeMeal lists over 4,500 of them in more than 65 countries.
• Kitchen precautions: for a severe allergy or a strict avoidance, your chef card asks for a clean pan, clean utensils and fresh oil, so cross-contact is taken seriously.
• Including: each food lists the forms it comes in, like peanut oil or peanut butter.

SHARE IT YOUR WAY
• QR code: the waiter scans it and your card opens on their phone, in their language. No app needed.
• Link: send it to the restaurant when you book, to your hotel, or to the grandparents, the school or the babysitter. It always shows your latest card, and you can turn it off anytime.
• Picture: save your card as an image in any language, for your photos or a message. Works offline, no account needed.

AT HOME AND ABROAD
• Any language, any day: show your card in Thai at the Thai restaurant down the street, or in Chinese at your favorite Chinese place.
• Works offline: your card is on your phone when you travel, with no signal and no roaming.
• One card per person: a profile for each family member or each diet. Swipe to switch.
• On your home screen: a widget shows your card or its QR code.

ONE CARD FOR EVERY DIET
Food allergies (peanut, tree nuts, shellfish, fish, egg, milk, sesame, soy, wheat, alpha-gal), celiac (coeliac) disease and gluten-free, lactose and fructose intolerance, low FODMAP, low histamine, pregnancy, halal, kosher, Jain, Hindu and Buddhist vegetarian, vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian and more. Can't find a food? Ask us to add it, right from the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, and your data is never sold. No account needed: your profiles stay on your phone. Sign in only if you want to back them up or share a link.

TRY IT FREE
Start with a 7-day free trial, then choose a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Every language, profile and feature is included: no fee per card, per language or per food. Full access requires a subscription or lifetime purchase after the trial. The subscription renews yearly until you cancel.

IMPORTANT
SafeMeal helps you explain what you can't eat. It does not guarantee that a meal is safe. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. Always confirm with the restaurant staff, read labels, carry your prescribed medication and follow your doctor's advice.

Many people with histamine intolerance eliminate too many foods unnecessarily. Your food diary data helps surface which foods may be worth reintroducing, so you can expand your elimination diet with more confidence instead of restricting forever.

Browse curated low-histamine meal ideas by category and read articles about managing histamine intolerance, mast cell activation, DAO supplements, elimination diets, and feeling better day to day.

description:
NutriSpy is a food diary that finds your patterns. A symptom that keeps coming back, a bad gut day, an afternoon with no energy — and no idea what caused it. Log what you eat, how you slept and how you feel, and NutriSpy puts it all on one timeline and shows you what goes with your worse days. Verifiable from week one, in your own days.

Make sense of your symptoms

Complaints often trail their trigger by hours, so memory alone rarely finds the connection. NutriSpy records meals and symptoms with their times and shows which habits and foods go with your better and worse days — more fat in the evening, a shorter night, fewer steps — what settles your digestion, and what leaves you drained. It is honest about how strong each pattern is — a hunch is labelled a hunch.

A food diary that fits your life

Log meals, symptoms, bowel movements, sleep, activity and supplements by voice, photo, barcode or text — one sentence is enough, NutriSpy structures it. Sleep and workouts sync from Apple Health or Health Connect, so your diary fills itself while you live your day.

See what actually helps you

Whether you want to calm your digestion, get to the bottom of a symptom, have more energy or sleep better, NutriSpy shows which foods and habits help and which hold you back. Your daily form tells you at a glance how the day is going, and a coach tip tells you what to try next. Want to lose weight or build muscle instead? Calories, protein and your weight trend sit side by side, with a calorie target that follows your goal. Full nutrient data sits underneath: calories, macros, fiber, vitamins, minerals, omega-3/6 and supplements. Fiber is counted under every meal, soluble and insoluble separately.

See your patterns

NutriSpy connects nutrition, digestion, symptoms, sleep, activity and cycle, and highlights the relationships that matter for you — "your bloating tends to follow high-fat evenings", not generic averages. A bowel movement or a symptom takes seconds to log and becomes part of the picture instead of another chore.

No pressure to be perfect

You don't have to log everything, every day. Miss a day and your insights still work — this food diary is built for real life, not streaks. Share your log with your doctor or coach whenever it helps.

Free food diary, Premium insights

The food diary is free, AI logging included: meals, symptoms, bowel movements, sleep and supplements by voice, photo or text, with calories and macros. Premium adds the insights: which foods and habits go with your symptoms, the full nutrient and FODMAP analysis with lactose, fructose and the polyols, six months of sleep trends, a coach tip on every entry, sync back to your health app, and a CSV or PDF report for your doctor. For IBS, food intolerance, histamine or heartburn, that makes your food log a symptom tracker. Prices in the app.

Important: NutriSpy is not a diagnostic tool and should not be used for medical diagnoses, treatments, or as a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult qualified healthcare professionals for health concerns or medical decisions.
